title.en: Volume 454 Biographies 241: Liu Jintang, Zhang Yao, Liu Dian Younger Brother: Zhuo Yun, Jin Shundi, Lian Shun, Deng Zeng, Tuo Yun Bu, Guo Quan, Liu Hongfa, Cao Zhengxing, Mu Tushan, Du Gaer, E Er Qing E, Feng Shen, Wen Lin, Ming Chun, Fu Leiminge, Xu Xuegong

sentences.zh: 列傳二百四十一

translations.literal: Biographies 241
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 241

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠張曜劉典弟倬雲

translations.literal: Liu Jintang, Zhang Yao, Liu Dian's younger brother Zhuo Yun
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang, Zhang Yao, and Liu Dian's younger brother Zhuo Yun

sentences.zh: 金順弟連順鄧增托雲布果權劉宏發曹正興

translations.literal: Jin Shun's younger brother Lian Shun, Deng Zeng, Tuo Yunbu, Guo Quan, Liu Hongfa, Cao Zhengxing
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun's younger brother Lian Shun, Deng Zeng, Tuo Yunbu, Guo Quan, Liu Hongfa, and Cao Zhengxing

sentences.zh: 穆圖善杜嘎爾額爾慶額丰紳文麟明春富勒銘額徐學功

translations.literal: Mu Tushan, Du Gaer, E Erqing'e, Feng Shen, Wen Lin, Ming Chun, Fuleiming'e, Xu Xuegong
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan, Du Gaer, E Erqing'e, Feng Shen, Wen Lin, Ming Chun, Fuleiming'e, and Xu Xuegong

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠，字毅齋，湖南湘鄉人，松山從子也。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang, courtesy name Yizhai, was a native of Xiangxiang, Hunan, and a nephew of Liu Songshan by the same clan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang, styled Yizhai, came from Xiangxiang in Hunan and was Liu Songshan's nephew.

sentences.zh: 從松山討捻，積勳至同知直隸州。

translations.literal: Following Songshan in campaigns against the Nian rebels, he accumulated merit until he reached the rank of subprefect of Zhili Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Songshan against the Nian rebels and rose through merit to subprefect of Zhili Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 從入陝，復同州、朝邑，釋省城圍，擢巡守道。

translations.literal: Following him into Shaanxi, he recovered Tongzhou and Chaoyi, lifted the siege of the provincial capital, and was promoted to intendant.
translations.idiomatic: When the army entered Shaanxi, he retook Tongzhou and Chaoyi, broke the siege of the provincial capital, and was promoted to intendant.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，左宗棠西征，從克懷遠、鎮邊，還定綏德，賜號法福凌阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi, during Zuo Zongtang's western expedition, he followed in capturing Huaiyuan and Zhenbian, then pacified Suide on the return march, and was granted the title Fafuling Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, on Zuo Zongtang's western campaign, he helped capture Huaiyuan and Zhenbian, pacified Suide on the return, and received the title Fafuling Baturn.

sentences.zh: 進軍甘肅，攻金積堡，夷旁近七寨，破靈州。

translations.literal: Advancing into Gansu, he attacked Jinjibao, destroyed seven nearby stockades, and captured Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing into Gansu, he besieged Jinjibao, razed seven neighboring forts, and took Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，擊馬五寨，松山戰死，詔加三品卿銜，接統其軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, while attacking Ma Wu's stockade, Songshan fell in battle; Jintang was ordered to add the third-rank vice minister title and take command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, during the assault on Ma Wu's fort, Songshan was killed in action. The court added a third-rank vice minister title to Jintang and put him in command of the army.

sentences.zh: 軍新敗，偏裨自恃為宿將，滋驕，錦棠禮詘之。

translations.literal: The army had just suffered defeat, and junior commanders, trusting in their long service, grew insolent; Jintang humbled them with courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: After the recent defeat, veteran subordinates grew arrogant; Jintang kept them in line through deliberate courtesy.

sentences.zh: 喪懸吳忠堡，或請徙它處，錦棠不可，曰：「櫬在軍，可係將士心。」

translations.literal: The coffin was kept at Wuzhong Fort; some asked to move it elsewhere, but Jintang refused, saying, "With the bier in camp, the men's hearts can be bound."
translations.idiomatic: The coffin remained at Wuzhong Fort. When some urged moving it, Jintang refused: "Keeping the bier with the army will hold the troops together."

sentences.zh: 宗棠貽書，為列堅守、退頓二策。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang sent a letter setting forth two plans: hold firm or withdraw and regroup.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang wrote offering two options: stand fast or fall back and regroup.

sentences.zh: 錦棠謂：「不力戰，則靈州不保，必效力致死，而後軍可全。」

translations.literal: Jintang said, "If we do not fight hard, Lingzhou cannot be saved; we must exert ourselves unto death, and only then can the army be preserved whole."
translations.idiomatic: Jintang replied: "Without a hard fight Lingzhou will fall. We must fight to the death—only then can the army survive intact."

sentences.zh: 於是一戰擒馬五，再戰破河、狄，軍復振。

translations.literal: Thereupon, in one battle he captured Ma Wu; in a second he broke the He and Di forces, and the army rallied again.
translations.idiomatic: In the first battle he captured Ma Wu; in the second he routed the He and Di rebels, and the army's morale revived.

sentences.zh: 是時馬化龍焰日熾，三決水困我軍，錦棠三拒之，不獲逞，糧且匱，率其子耀邦乞款附。

translations.literal: At this time Ma Hualong's power grew daily; thrice he breached dikes to flood the imperial army, and thrice Jintang repelled him without letting him succeed. With grain running short, Hualong led his son Yaobang to sue for surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Hualong's strength was rising. Three times he broke dikes to flood the imperial lines; three times Jintang held him off. Short of grain, Hualong came with his son Yaobang to offer surrender.

sentences.zh: 錦棠曰：「諾。

translations.literal: Jintang said, "Agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang said, "Very well.

sentences.zh: 令若先繳馬械。」

translations.literal: Have your men surrender their horses and weapons first."
translations.idiomatic: Have your men turn in their horses and arms first."

sentences.zh: 不應，再引馬連水入湖。

translations.literal: There was no response; Hualong again diverted the Maliang River into the lake.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong did not comply and again diverted the Maliang River into the lake.

sentences.zh: 會大風從西北起，濤齧堤岸，勢洶湧。

translations.literal: Just then a great wind rose from the northwest; waves gnawed at the dikes and banks, and the surge was furious.
translations.idiomatic: A gale blew up from the northwest; waves tore at the dikes and the flood surged violently.

sentences.zh: 錦棠囊土以御，化龍計益窘，哀詞乞耕墾。

translations.literal: Jintang used sandbags to hold the line; Hualong's stratagem grew ever tighter, and he pleaded piteously to be allowed to farm and settle.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang piled sandbags against the breach. Hualong's position worsened, and he begged in abject terms for permission to farm.

sentences.zh: 錦棠知其詐，隱卒下橋、永寧洞，又敗去，乘勢下蔡家橋，克東關。

translations.literal: Jintang knew it was a ruse; he hid troops below Xiqiao and Yongning Cave, routed the enemy again, pressed the advantage to Xiajia Bridge, and captured the East Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing through the deception, Jintang concealed troops at Xiqiao and Yongning Cave, defeated Hualong again, pushed on to Xiajia Bridge, and took the East Gate.

sentences.zh: 化龍度不得脫，於是三踵軍門乞撫矣。

translations.literal: Hualong saw he could not escape, and so three times he followed the army gate to beg for pacification.
translations.idiomatic: Convinced he could not break free, Hualong came three times to the camp gate to plead for amnesty.

sentences.zh: 錦棠白宗棠請進止，乃徙陝回化平川，而分置甘回於靈州。

translations.literal: Jintang reported to Zuo Zongtang for instructions, then resettled the Shaanxi Muslims at Huapingchuan and distributed the Gansu Muslims around Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang asked Zuo Zongtang for orders, then moved the Shaanxi Muslims to Huapingchuan and settled Gansu Muslims around Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 論功，予雲騎尉世職，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank and awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank and a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 十年，誅化龍父子，生致馬八條，置喪所，臠而祭之，遂輿喪歸。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he executed Hualong and his son, took Ma Batiao alive, placed him at the mourning site, cut him to pieces as a sacrifice, and then returned home with the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he put Hualong and his son to death, captured Ma Batiao alive, dismembered him as an offering at the mourning site, and then escorted the coffin home.

sentences.zh: 明年，度隴攻西寧。

translations.literal: The next year he crossed Longshan to attack Xining.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he crossed the Long Mountains to attack Xining.

sentences.zh: 次碾伯平戎驛，先破小峽，遣軍奪南北兩山，圍解，道員郭襄之率男婦二萬繦負來迎。

translations.literal: He halted at Pingyi Post in Nianbo, first broke Xiaoxia Pass, sent troops to seize the two hills north and south, lifted the siege, and Intendant Guo Xiangzhi led twenty thousand men, women, and children, swaddled and carried, to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Camping at Pingyi Post in Nianbo, he broke Xiaoxia Pass first, sent troops to take the hills north and south, lifted the siege, and Intendant Guo Xiangzhi came out with twenty thousand men, women, and children to greet him.

sentences.zh: 是役也，提湘軍八十營，扼攻九十里，往往徹夜不休，露立冰天雪窖中，詔嘉之。

translations.literal: In this campaign he led eighty Hunan Army battalions, pressing the attack for ninety li, often working through the night without rest, standing exposed in ice and snow; the court commended him.
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign he led eighty Hunan battalions in a ninety-li assault, often fighting through the night in freezing snow. The court praised his exertions.

sentences.zh: 十二年，克大通，斬叛官馬壽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he captured Datong and executed the rebel official Ma Shou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he took Datong and beheaded the rebel official Ma Shou.

sentences.zh: 遴陝回為旌善五旗，餘徙平涼、秦安、清水。

translations.literal: He selected Shaanxi Muslims for the five Jingshan banners; the rest were moved to Pingliang, Qin'an, and Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: He organized selected Shaanxi Muslims into the five Jingshan banners and resettled the rest at Pingliang, Qin'an, and Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎奔肅州。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu fled to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu fled to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 方湘軍之定西寧也，宗棠緣事責錦棠，盛氣辨，銜之，以故徇肅州未下，亦不召。

translations.literal: Just as the Hunan Army was pacifying Xining, Zuo Zongtang blamed Jintang over an incident; Jintang argued back heatedly, and Zuo resented it. For this reason, though Suzhou had not yet fallen, he did not summon Jintang.
translations.idiomatic: While the Hunan Army was securing Xining, Zuo Zongtang rebuked Jintang over a dispute; Jintang answered hotly and Zuo took offense. Even though Suzhou remained untaken, he did not call Jintang forward.

sentences.zh: 及錦棠至，又大喜，為夸其軍以勵眾。

translations.literal: When Jintang arrived, Zuo was greatly pleased and praised his army to encourage the rest.
translations.idiomatic: When Jintang finally arrived, Zuo was delighted and publicly praised his troops to hearten the whole force.

sentences.zh: 錦棠計誅馬天祿，殺土回、客回立盡，關隴平。

translations.literal: Jintang planned the execution of Ma Tianlu; local and migrant Muslims were killed to the last, and Guanlong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang engineered the execution of Ma Tianlu, wiped out the local and migrant Muslim bands, and pacified Guanlong.

sentences.zh: 權西寧道。

translations.literal: He served as acting Xining intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He served as acting intendant of Xining.

sentences.zh: 明年，破河州，獲閃殿臣，伏誅。

translations.literal: The next year he broke Hezhou, captured Shan Dianchén, and had him executed.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he took Hezhou, captured Shan Dianchén, and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 乃合諸將蹙回於賈家集、郭家嘴，殲焉。

translations.literal: He then joined the other generals in pressing the Muslims at Jiajiaji and Guojiazui and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined other commanders in cornering the Muslim forces at Jiajiaji and Guojiazui and destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，出關。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he passed out of the frontier pass.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he marched beyond the frontier pass.

sentences.zh: 時彥虎走依安集延，帕夏阿古柏助之，勢复熾。

translations.literal: At this time Yanhu had fled to Kokand; the Khan Ya'qub Beg aided him, and their power revived.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu had taken refuge with Kokand, and Ya'qub Beg's support revived rebel strength.

sentences.zh: 二年，至阜康，與金順計事，議先攻古牧。

translations.literal: In the second year he reached Fukang, consulted with Jin Shun, and agreed to attack Gumul first.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he reached Fukang, conferred with Jin Shun, and decided to strike Gumul first.

sentences.zh: 遣將分壁木壘河，而自領軍軍九營街。

translations.literal: He sent generals to encamp separately along the Mulei River while he personally led the army at Jiuying Street.
translations.idiomatic: He posted generals along the Mulei River and personally commanded the main force at Jiuying Street.

sentences.zh: 度戈壁乏水，佯掘井以懈敵，陰遣精騎襲奪黃田，通汲道，收古牧地。

translations.literal: Judging the Gobi short of water, he feigned digging wells to lull the enemy, secretly sent elite cavalry to seize and capture Huangtian, opened a water route, and recovered Gumul territory.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the Gobi was waterless, he pretended to dig wells to lull the enemy, then sent elite cavalry to seize Huangtian, secure a water route, and recover Gumul.

sentences.zh: 錦棠策烏城寇必駭奔，復自將精兵走之，遂復烏魯木齊、迪化，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: Jintang reckoned the enemy at Wucheng would flee in panic; he again personally led elite troops in pursuit, recovered Urumqi and Dihua, and was granted a hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank.
translations.idiomatic: Expecting the Wucheng garrison to flee in panic, Jintang led elite troops in pursuit, retook Urumqi and Dihua, and received a hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 三年春，踰嶺西南攻達坂。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year he crossed the pass southwest to attack Daban.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he crossed the mountains southwest to attack Daban.

sentences.zh: 寇引湖水衛城，泥深及馬腹。

translations.literal: The enemy diverted lake water to defend the city; mud ran deep to the horses' bellies.
translations.idiomatic: The defenders flooded the approaches with lake water; mud came up to the horses' bellies.

sentences.zh: 錦棠周城徼循，誡各營警備。

translations.literal: Jintang circled the city on patrol and ordered every camp to stay alert.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang patrolled the perimeter and ordered every camp to remain on guard.

sentences.zh: 列燧如白晝，轟擊之，彈落爆藥窖，聲砉然，人馬碎裂。

translations.literal: Beacon fires lined up bright as day; bombardment struck, a shell fell on a powder magazine, the blast rang sharply, and men and horses were torn apart.
translations.idiomatic: Signal fires lit the night like day. Shellfire hit a powder store; the explosion shattered men and horses.

sentences.zh: 乃下令軍中曰：「能縛獻服異服者賞。」

translations.literal: He then ordered the army: "Whoever binds and presents captives in foreign dress will be rewarded."
translations.idiomatic: He then proclaimed: "Reward for anyone who captures and brings in men in foreign dress."

sentences.zh: 於是愛伊德爾呼里以下皆就俘，愛伊德爾呼裡，猶華言「大總管」也。

translations.literal: Thereupon Aiyideer Huli and those below him all surrendered as prisoners; Aiyideer Huli means "grand steward" in Chinese.
translations.idiomatic: Aiyideer Huli and his subordinates were taken captive. Aiyideer Huli is the Turkic equivalent of "grand steward."

sentences.zh: 且釋降回數千，給貲糧縱歸。

translations.literal: He also released several thousand surrendered Muslims, gave them provisions and money, and let them go.
translations.idiomatic: He also released several thousand surrendered Muslims, gave them provisions, and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 或請其故，曰：「俾歸為我宣播朝威也，吾欲以不戰勝之。」

translations.literal: When asked why, he said, "Let them return to spread the court's majesty for us; I wish to win without fighting."
translations.idiomatic: Asked why, he said: "Let them spread word of the court's power at home. I mean to win without fighting."

sentences.zh: 自是破吐魯番、托克遜，南路門洞開，阿古柏如失左右手，亦被執，飲藥死。

translations.literal: From then on he broke Turfan and Toksun; the southern route lay wide open. Ya'qub Beg, as if losing both arms, was also captured and died by poison.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he took Turfan and Toksun and opened the southern road. Ya'qub Beg, bereft of support, was captured and died by poison.

sentences.zh: 賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: He was awarded double-peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: He was awarded double-peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 已而彥虎據開都河西岸，覬入俄。

translations.literal: Soon Yanhu held the west bank of the Kaidu River, hoping to enter Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Yanhu held the west bank of the Kaidu River, hoping to slip into Russia.

sentences.zh: 師抵曲惠，與餘虎恩分擊，彥虎亦決水以阻。

translations.literal: The army reached Quhui; with Yu Hu'en he attacked separately, and Yanhu also broke dikes to obstruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The army reached Quhui. Jintang and Yu Hu'en attacked from separate directions, and Yanhu broke dikes to block them.

sentences.zh: 錦棠入喀喇沙爾城，廬舍漂沒，乃徙和碩特帳房河東數百戶，實後路，复庫爾勒。

translations.literal: Jintang entered Karashahr; houses were washed away, so he moved several hundred Khoshut tent households east of the river to secure the rear and recovered Korla.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Karashahr, Jintang found dwellings swept away. He resettled several hundred Khoshut households east of the river to secure the rear and retook Korla.

sentences.zh: 會軍中患飢乏，下令掘窖糧，獲數千石以濟。

translations.literal: When the army suffered hunger and shortage, he ordered buried grain dug up and obtained several thousand shi to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army ran short of food, he ordered buried stores dug up and recovered several thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 連下庫車、拜城。

translations.literal: He captured Kucha and Baicheng in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He took Kucha and Baicheng in succession.

sentences.zh: 其南纏回苦安集延淫暴久，重以彥虎奔擾，益不堪命，旦夕望我軍如時雨。

translations.literal: To the south the Taranchi Muslims had long suffered Kokand's tyranny; Yanhu's raids made life unbearable, and day and night they looked for the imperial army like timely rain.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Taranchis had long suffered Kokand's oppression; Yanhu's raids made life unbearable, and they awaited the imperial army like rain in drought.

sentences.zh: 比至，各城阿奇木伯克、阿渾玉子巴什各攜潼酪，持牛羊來犒師。

translations.literal: When the army arrived, the aqim beg and ahun of each city, with yuzibashi, each brought curds and cheese and cattle and sheep to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the army arrived, each city's aqim beg, ahun, and yuzibashi came with curds, cheese, cattle, and sheep to welcome the troops.

sentences.zh: 抵阿克蘇，錦棠先入城，受降畢，回皆伏服。

translations.literal: Reaching Aksu, Jintang entered the city first; after accepting surrender, all the Muslims submitted.
translations.idiomatic: At Aksu, Jintang entered the city first. After the surrender ceremony, the Muslims submitted completely.

sentences.zh: 聞彥虎奔烏什，亟遣旌善旗渡河復其城。

translations.literal: Hearing Yanhu had fled toward Ush, he urgently sent the Jingshan banner across the river to recover the city.
translations.idiomatic: Learning Yanhu had fled toward Ush, he sent the Jingshan banner across the river at once to retake the city.

sentences.zh: 於是東四城俱下，詔晉三品京卿。

translations.literal: Thereupon all four eastern cities fell; he was promoted by decree to third-rank metropolitan official.
translations.idiomatic: All four eastern cities then fell, and he was promoted to third-rank metropolitan official.

sentences.zh: 值喀城守備何步雲告亟，遂大舉出師，令虎恩、黃萬鵬分道進取，而自率師徑搗葉爾羌，並克之。

translations.literal: When Kashgar garrison commander He Buyun reported urgent danger, he mounted a major expedition, ordered Hu'en and Huang Wanpeng to advance by separate routes, and personally led the army straight against Yarkand and captured both.
translations.idiomatic: When Kashgar's garrison commander He Buyun sent urgent word, Jintang launched a major campaign. Hu'en and Huang Wanpeng advanced on separate routes while he led the main force straight at Yarkand and took both cities.

sentences.zh: 彥虎遁入俄。

translations.literal: Yanhu escaped into Russia.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhu fled into Russia.

sentences.zh: 錦棠進定英吉沙爾，遣董福祥收和闐，西四城亦下，錫二等男。

translations.literal: Jintang advanced to secure Yengisar, sent Dong Fuxiang to recover Khotan, and the four western cities also fell; he was granted the second rank of baron.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang secured Yengisar, sent Dong Fuxiang to take Khotan, and the four western cities fell as well. He was ennobled as a second-class baron.

sentences.zh: 四年，錦棠既定喀城，以次巡歷葉爾羌、和闐。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, after Jintang had pacified Kashgar, he toured Yarkand and Khotan in turn.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, after pacifying Kashgar, Jintang toured Yarkand and Khotan in succession.

sentences.zh: 凡西人僑居其地者，英乳目阿喇伯十餘人，印度溫都斯坦五千餘人，咸服其勇略，稱為「飛將軍」雲。

translations.literal: All Westerners living there—more than ten British and Arab merchants and over five thousand Indian and Turkestanis—admired his courage and strategy and called him the "Flying General."
translations.idiomatic: Western residents there—more than ten British and Arab traders and over five thousand Indians and Central Asians—all admired his daring and called him the "Flying General."

sentences.zh: 方彥虎之入俄也，俄人處之阿爾瑪圖。

translations.literal: When Yanhu entered Russia, the Russians settled him at Almaty.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanhu entered Russia, the Russians placed him at Almaty.

sentences.zh: 錦棠猶致書圖爾齊斯坦總督，謂將入境搜捕，宗棠勸止之。

translations.literal: Jintang still wrote the Turkestan governor saying he would cross the border to hunt him down; Zuo Zongtang advised against it.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang wrote the Turkestan governor that he intended to cross the border in pursuit, but Zuo Zongtang dissuaded him.

sentences.zh: 俄复徙之託呼瑪克。

translations.literal: The Russians again moved Yanhu to Tokmak.
translations.idiomatic: The Russians then moved Yanhu to Tokmak.

sentences.zh: 其秋，彥虎又遣黨犯烏什邊，驟入格爾品。

translations.literal: That autumn Yanhu again sent followers to raid the Ush border and suddenly entered Ge'erpin.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Yanhu's followers raided the Ush border and suddenly entered Ge'erpin.

sentences.zh: 錦棠扼之瑪喇爾巴什，別遣將要其歸路，大敗之。

translations.literal: Jintang blocked them at Maralbeshi and separately sent a general to cut off their retreat, inflicting a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang blocked them at Maralbeshi and sent another general to cut off their retreat, routing them completely.

sentences.zh: 未幾，安集延入，又破之玉都巴什。

translations.literal: Before long Kokand forces entered and were again defeated at Yudubashi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kokand raiders crossed in and were defeated again at Yudubashi.

sentences.zh: 是歲補太常寺卿，轉通政使。

translations.literal: That year he was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and then transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Office of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 五年，安夷复構布魯特內犯，戰烏帕爾，捕斬二千餘級。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Andijani again incited the Kirghiz to raid inward; at battle at Wupa'er more than two thousand were captured or killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Andijani agitators stirred the Kirghiz to raid again. At Wupa'er more than two thousand were killed or captured.

sentences.zh: 自是邊寇頗息警。

translations.literal: From then on border raids largely quieted.
translations.idiomatic: After that border raids largely subsided.

sentences.zh: 維時俄據伊犁，宗棠疏請崇其秩，資鎮撫，詔佐軍事。

translations.literal: At this time Russia held Ili; Zuo Zongtang memorialized to elevate Jintang's rank to aid in pacification, and he was ordered to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Russia then held Ili. Zuo Zongtang memorialized to raise Jintang's rank for frontier pacification, and the court ordered him to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 俄益增兵守納林河。

translations.literal: Russia further increased troops guarding the Nalin River.
translations.idiomatic: Russia also reinforced its garrison on the Nalin River.

sentences.zh: 已，宗棠入都，上以此專屬任錦棠關外事，命署欽差大臣。

translations.literal: Soon Zuo Zongtang entered the capital; the throne entrusted frontier affairs exclusively to Jintang and appointed him acting Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang went to the capital, the throne put frontier affairs entirely in Jintang's hands and named him acting Imperial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 徙頓哈密，益治軍。

translations.literal: He moved his headquarters to Hami and further drilled the army.
translations.idiomatic: He moved headquarters to Hami and redoubled military training.

sentences.zh: 逾歲除真。

translations.literal: After a year he was confirmed in the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the appointment was made permanent.

sentences.zh: 八年，和議成，錦棠策善後，請設新疆行省，省置巡撫、布政使，加鎮迪道按察使銜，道、府、州、縣視內地。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, after peace was concluded, Jintang planned postwar settlement and requested establishing Xinjiang as a province with a governor and provincial treasurer, adding the surveillance commissioner title to the Zhendi intendant, and organizing circuits, prefectures, departments, and counties like the interior.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, after peace was made, Jintang planned reconstruction and proposed making Xinjiang a province with governor and treasurer, giving the Zhendi intendant surveillance commissioner rank, and organizing circuits and counties on the interior model.

sentences.zh: 立城垣、壇廟、學校、驛傳，又廣屯田，興水利。

translations.literal: He built city walls, altars and temples, schools, and post stations, and also expanded garrison farming and promoted waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: He built walls, temples, schools, and post roads, expanded garrison farming, and developed irrigation.

sentences.zh: 南疆歲徵賦至二十餘萬石。

translations.literal: Southern Xinjiang's annual tax grain reached more than two hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Xinjiang's annual tax grain reached more than two hundred thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢兵部右侍郎，加尚書銜，旋除新疆巡撫，仍行欽差事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of War, given a minister's title, then appointed governor of Xinjiang while continuing as Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was promoted to Vice Minister of War with ministerial rank, then appointed governor of Xinjiang while retaining his commission.

sentences.zh: 十一年，進駐烏魯木齊，奏省參贊大臣，改置都統，設喀什噶爾、阿克蘇、巴里坤提鎮各營。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he advanced headquarters to Urumqi, memorialized to abolish the Ili councilor, replace him with a general, and establish brigade garrisons at Kashgar, Aksu, and Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he moved headquarters to Urumqi, abolished the Ili councilor in favor of a general, and established brigade garrisons at Kashgar, Aksu, and Barkul.

sentences.zh: 復增道、府、廳、縣，徙分防官駐要塞，南北郡縣之制始定。

translations.literal: He further added circuits, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties, moved garrison officials to key strongpoints, and the north-south system of commanderies and counties was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: He added circuits, prefectures, subprefectures, and counties, posted garrison officials at key points, and fixed the administrative system across north and south Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 先是，錦棠以祖母老病，累疏乞歸省，不許。

translations.literal: Earlier, because his grandmother was old and ill, Jintang repeatedly memorialized to return home on leave and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Jintang had repeatedly asked leave to visit his ailing grandmother, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 十三年，申前請，始俞允。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he renewed the request and was at last granted approval.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he renewed the request and was finally allowed to go.

sentences.zh: 錦棠悉召諸部酋長大酺，遂發。

translations.literal: Jintang summoned all the tribal chiefs to a great feast, then set out.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang summoned the tribal chiefs to a farewell feast and then departed.

sentences.zh: 所過，黃童白叟望風相攜負以迎，往往擁車數日不得走。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed, old and young came out to welcome him, often crowding his carriage for days so he could not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere he went, young and old turned out to welcome him, often crowding his carriage for days so he could hardly move.

sentences.zh: 十五年，加太子少保銜。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was given the Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he received the Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent title.

sentences.zh: 明年，晉太子太保。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十年，晉錫一等男。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was further ennobled as a first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was raised to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 會弟鼒以山西按察使入覲，垂詢近狀，欲強起之。

translations.literal: When his younger brother Cai came to court as Shanxi surveillance commissioner, the throne inquired after recent affairs and wished to force Jintang back into service.
translations.idiomatic: When his brother Cai came to court as Shanxi surveillance commissioner, the throne asked after him and intended to recall Jintang to duty.

sentences.zh: 適中日有違言，電旨趣召，未行而病作，朝廷書問日數至。

translations.literal: Just then Sino-Japanese tensions arose; telegraphic orders urgently summoned him, but before he could depart illness set in, and imperial inquiries arrived daily.
translations.idiomatic: Tensions with Japan were rising; urgent telegraphic orders summoned him, but illness struck before he could leave, and imperial inquiries arrived daily.

sentences.zh: 疾革時，猶喃喃呼舊校指述邊事。

translations.literal: At the height of his illness he still murmured, calling old staff to describe frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Even at death's door he murmured to old aides, recounting frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，年五十一。

translations.literal: Before long he died, aged fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he died, aged fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 事聞，震悼，諡襄勤，予建祠。

translations.literal: When the news arrived, the court was deeply grieved; he was posthumously titled Xiangqin and granted a memorial shrine.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, the throne mourned him deeply, posthumously titled him Xiangqin, and ordered a memorial shrine built.

sentences.zh: 張曜，字朗齋，其先上虞人，改籍大興，既，复隸錢塘。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao, courtesy name Langzhai, was originally from Shangyu; his household register was changed to Daxing, and later again to Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao, styled Langzhai, came originally from Shangyu; his family register was moved first to Daxing and later to Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 生有神力，幼嘗持竿結陣，部勒群兒，無敢譁者。

translations.literal: Born with great strength, as a child he once took a pole to form battle lines and drill the other boys; none dared make noise.
translations.idiomatic: He was born with unusual strength. As a boy he would line up playmates with a pole and drill them like soldiers; none dared disobey.

sentences.zh: 少長，依舊脈蒯賀蓀。

translations.literal: When he grew up, he relied on a kinsman, Kuai Hesun.
translations.idiomatic: When he grew older he lived under the patronage of his kinsman Kuai Hesun.

sentences.zh: 賀蓀宰固始，適豫捻起，集團勇三百屬之。

translations.literal: Hesun was magistrate of Gushi; just as the Henan Nian rebels rose, he gathered three hundred militiamen and placed them under Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Hesun was magistrate of Gushi. When the Henan Nian rebels rose, he raised three hundred militiamen and put Yao in command.

sentences.zh: 捻起至，時已昏。

translations.literal: The Nian arrived just as dusk fell.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian arrived at dusk.

sentences.zh: 曜獻策，謂：「伏軍城外，彼不知眾寡，可以計走也。」

translations.literal: Yao offered a plan, saying, "Ambush troops outside the city; they will not know our numbers and can be driven off by stratagem."
translations.idiomatic: Yao proposed: "Ambush men outside the walls. Not knowing our strength, the enemy can be tricked into retreat."

sentences.zh: 夜半，捻縱掠，轟擊退。

translations.literal: At midnight the Nian spread out to plunder; cannon fire drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the Nian spread out to loot; a cannon barrage drove them off.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁追捻亟，遙見火光，詢知為曜部，召與語，其悅，命從軍。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen was pressing the Nian hard; seeing firelight in the distance, he learned it was Yao's unit, summoned and spoke with him, was pleased, and ordered him to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen was hot on the Nian trail. Seeing distant firelight, he learned it was Yao's force, summoned him, was impressed, and took him into the army.

sentences.zh: 積勳為知縣，權知固始。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he became county magistrate and served as acting magistrate of Gushi.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated merit he became a county magistrate and served as acting magistrate of Gushi.

sentences.zh: 皖捻來犯，嬰城守，寇駸駸西去。

translations.literal: When Anhui Nian rebels came to attack, he held the city; the bandits gradually moved west.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui Nian rebels attacked, he held the city while the bandits drifted westward.

sentences.zh: 亡何，李秀成又構捻入，圍城三匝。

translations.literal: Before long Li Xiucheng again incited the Nian to enter and besieged the city on three sides.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Li Xiucheng stirred up the Nian again; they entered and besieged the city on three sides.

sentences.zh: 捍禦七十餘日，城獲全。

translations.literal: He defended for more than seventy days and the city was preserved.
translations.idiomatic: After more than seventy days of defense the city held.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其功，賜號霍欽巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The throne praised his merit and granted the title Huoqin Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised his service and granted the title Huoqin Baturn.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年，擢知府。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he was promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 10 he was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 先後遭憂，仍留軍討皖捻。

translations.literal: Though bereaved twice in succession, he remained with the army to suppress the Anhui Nian.
translations.idiomatic: Despite successive bereavements he stayed with the army to fight the Anhui Nian.

sentences.zh: 屢捷，晉道員。

translations.literal: After repeated victories he was promoted to intendant.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated victories he rose to intendant.

sentences.zh: 明年，除河南布政使。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed Henan provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was appointed Henan provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 是時陳大喜、張鳳林各樹幟，延擾數千里。

translations.literal: At this time Chen Daxi and Zhang Fenglin each raised banners and ravaged lands for thousands of li.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Daxi and Zhang Fenglin each raised banners and ravaged thousands of li of territory.

sentences.zh: 曜謂寇援斷，師未能驟克，寨中患飢乏，多猜貳，宜廣設購募間其黨。

translations.literal: Yao said that with enemy reinforcements cut off the army could not take the stockade at once; the camp suffered hunger and shortages and many grew doubtful; rewards and recruitment should be widely offered to sow discord among their ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Yao argued that with enemy aid cut off the army could not storm the fort at once; hunger and suspicion spread in camp, so he widened rewards and recruitment to turn the rebels against one another.

sentences.zh: 乃縱降者為內應，捻乃竄，諷諭各寨，皆款服。

translations.literal: He then let surrendered men serve as inside agents; the Nian fled, and he persuaded each stockade in turn until all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He used surrendered men as inside agents; the Nian broke and fled, and he persuaded the stockades one by one to submit.

sentences.zh: 鳳林偽降，計擒之。

translations.literal: Fenglin feigned surrender and was captured by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Fenglin feigned surrender and was taken by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，御史劉毓楠劾其目不識丁，詔改總兵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Censor Liu Yunan impeached him for illiteracy, and he was ordered demoted to brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1, Censor Liu Yunan impeached him as illiterate, and he was demoted to brigade general.

sentences.zh: 二年，大喜走阜陽，戰秦宣寨。

translations.literal: In the second year Daxi fled to Fuyang; battle was joined at Qinxuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Daxi fled to Fuyang and fighting broke out at Qinxuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 皖捻復入，曜慮華莊失，亟斂兵退，以銳師宵加之，殲渠率。

translations.literal: When Anhui Nian re-entered, Yao feared losing Huazhuang, quickly drew troops back, then sent crack forces by night to strike and wiped out the rebel leaders.
translations.idiomatic: When Anhui Nian re-entered, Yao feared losing Huazhuang, pulled back, then sent crack troops by night and wiped out the rebel leaders.

sentences.zh: 時張總愚走鄢陵、臨潁欲西，曜拒之嵩山麓，令不得西。

translations.literal: At this time Zhang Zongyu fled toward Yanling and Linying intending to go west; Yao blocked him at the foot of Mount Song and kept him from going west.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyu was fleeing toward Yanling and Linying to go west; Yao blocked him at Mount Song and kept him from crossing west.

sentences.zh: 攻大金店，援寇四起，遣總兵保英略中路，為寇乘。

translations.literal: Attacking Dajin Store, relief rebels rose on all sides; he sent Brigade General Bao Ying to hold the center route, but the enemy took advantage.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Dajin Store, he met relief rebels on every side; Brigade General Bao Ying held the center but the enemy broke through.

sentences.zh: 擢手刃退縮者，士氣乃奮，卒敗之。

translations.literal: Yao personally killed those who shrank back; morale revived and the enemy was finally defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Yao personally killed men who fell back; morale revived and the enemy was finally beaten.

sentences.zh: 攻太子望寨，久相持。

translations.literal: Attacking Taiziwang Stockade, the two sides were locked in stalemate for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The assault on Taiziwang Stockade dragged on in stalemate.

sentences.zh: 曜曰：「捻詭悍，堅守山口，阻我進兵。

translations.literal: Yao said, "The Nian are cunning and fierce; holding the mountain passes blocks our advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yao said: "The Nian are cunning and fierce; holding the passes blocks our advance.

sentences.zh: 坐為所綴，非策也。」

translations.literal: To sit and be delayed by them is no strategy."
translations.idiomatic: Sitting here while they tie us down is no strategy."

sentences.zh: 間道出奇擊之。

translations.literal: He took a hidden route and struck with a surprise force.
translations.idiomatic: He took a hidden route and struck with a surprise force.

sentences.zh: 總愚西北走鎮平，追殺黑龍集。

translations.literal: Zongyu fled northwest toward Zhenping; Yao pursued and killed him at Heilongji.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyu fled northwest to Zhenping; Yao pursued and killed him at Heilongji.

sentences.zh: 犯南陽，又戰卻之。

translations.literal: When the rebels invaded Nanyang, he fought them off again.
translations.idiomatic: When they raided Nanyang he fought them off again.

sentences.zh: 三年，捻會宛南，總愚赴盧氏，嗾粵寇入豫。

translations.literal: In the third year the Nian gathered south of Nanyang; Zongyu went to Lushi and incited Guangdong rebels to enter Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the Nian gathered south of Nanyang; Zongyu went to Lushi and stirred Guangdong rebels to enter Henan.

sentences.zh: 曜扼之，使不能合。

translations.literal: Yao blocked them and kept the forces from joining.
translations.idiomatic: Yao blocked them and kept the forces from joining.

sentences.zh: 次橋川，寇自西北至，狙伏以擊，寇奔楚。

translations.literal: Halting at Qiaochuan, rebels came from the northwest; he lay in ambush and struck, and the rebels fled toward Chu.
translations.idiomatic: At Qiaochuan rebels came from the northwest; he ambushed them and they fled toward Chu.

sentences.zh: 曜浮渡丹江，追越鄖西百四十里，會陝、楚軍至而還。

translations.literal: Yao crossed the Dan River by raft, pursued more than a hundred and forty li west of Yun, and returned when Shaanxi and Chu armies arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Yao rafted the Dan River and pursued more than 140 li west of Yun before returning when Shaanxi and Hubei troops arrived.

sentences.zh: 四年，僧格林沁軍麻城，騶騎失利。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen's army was at Macheng and his vanguard cavalry suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Sengge Rinchen's army was at Macheng when his vanguard cavalry was defeated.

sentences.zh: 曜赴難，七戰皆克。

translations.literal: Yao rushed to the rescue; in seven battles all were won.
translations.idiomatic: Yao rushed to help; he won seven battles in succession.

sentences.zh: 僧王既戰死，台臣劾其養寇遺患。

translations.literal: After the Prince was killed in battle, censorial officials impeached Yao for nurturing bandits and leaving future trouble.
translations.idiomatic: After the prince died in battle, censors impeached Yao for letting bandits survive and sow future trouble.

sentences.zh: 巡撫吳昌壽按覆，事白，曜假歸葬親。

translations.literal: Governor Wu Changshou investigated and cleared the matter; Yao took leave to bury his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Wu Changshou investigated and cleared him; Yao took leave to bury his parents.

sentences.zh: 逾年，淮北捻益亟。

translations.literal: A year later the northern Huai Nian grew ever more pressing.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the northern Huai Nian grew ever more threatening.

sentences.zh: 朝旨趣復出，曜遂部合新舊選鋒號嵩武軍。

translations.literal: Imperial orders urgently recalled him; Yao then organized old and new picked vanguard units under the name Songwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders urgently recalled him; Yao reorganized old and new picked vanguard units as the Songwu Army.

sentences.zh: 厥後軍氣大振，論者謂為湘、淮軍後勁雲。

translations.literal: Thereafter army morale greatly revived; commentators called it the strongest reserve after the Hunan and Huai armies.
translations.idiomatic: Army morale revived sharply; commentators called it the strongest reserve after the Hunan and Huai armies.

sentences.zh: 六年，出頓許州八里橋，任柱等見曜大纛，駴走。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he went out and encamped at Bali Bridge, Xuzhou; Ren Zhu and others saw Yao's great banner and fled in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he encamped at Bali Bridge in Xuzhou; Ren Zhu and others saw Yao's banner and fled in alarm.

sentences.zh: 梁山寇與合，五日至鉅野，渡運而東。

translations.literal: Liangshan bandits joined them; in five days they reached Juye and crossed the Grand Canal eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Liangshan bandits joined them; in five days they reached Juye and crossed the Grand Canal eastward.

sentences.zh: 曜與總兵宋慶往馳之。

translations.literal: Yao and Brigade General Song Qing galloped after them.
translations.idiomatic: Yao and Brigade General Song Qing galloped after them.

sentences.zh: 當是時，李鴻章議防運河北。

translations.literal: At this time Li Hongzhang planned to defend north of the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang was planning to defend north of the Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 首安山訖沈家口。

translations.literal: From Anshan first to Shenjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: From Anshan to Shenjiakou first.

sentences.zh: 曜等至，令慶築長牆。

translations.literal: When Yao and the others arrived, he ordered Qing to build a long wall.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao arrived he ordered Qing to build a long wall.

sentences.zh: 慶留副將蔣東才、參將李承先二軍屬曜。

translations.literal: Qing left Deputy Commander Jiang Dongcai and Colonel Li Chengxian with two armies under Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Qing left Deputy Commander Jiang Dongcai and Colonel Li Chengxian with two armies under Yao.

sentences.zh: 曜以沈家口黃、運交匯，調黃河水師入運助守。

translations.literal: Because at Shenjiakou the Yellow River and Grand Canal met, Yao moved Yellow River naval forces into the canal to help defend.
translations.idiomatic: At Shenjiakou, where the Yellow River and Grand Canal met, Yao brought Yellow River naval forces into the canal to help defend.

sentences.zh: 守河防運自此始。

translations.literal: River defense to protect the canal began from this.
translations.idiomatic: River defense to protect the canal began here.

sentences.zh: 久之，總愚陷陝綏德，分擾米脂。

translations.literal: After a long time Zongyu took Suide in Shaanxi and sent detachments to raid Mizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zongyu took Suide in Shaanxi and sent detachments to raid Mizhi.

sentences.zh: 朝命防河北。

translations.literal: The court ordered defense north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered defense north of the river.

sentences.zh: 捻濟河入晉，犯吉州鄉寧，平、蒲告警。

translations.literal: The Nian crossed the river into Shanxi, invaded Jizhou and Xiangning, and Pingyang and Puzhou raised alarms.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian crossed into Shanxi, raided Jizhou and Xiangning, and alarms rose in Pingyang and Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 檄曜還豫，而捻已自絳州曲沃入偪豫疆，曜乃追敗之湯陰。

translations.literal: Orders recalled Yao to Henan, but the Nian had already entered from Quwo in Jiangzhou and threatened Henan borders; Yao pursued and defeated them at Tangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Orders recalled Yao to Henan, but the Nian had already entered from Quwo and threatened the border; Yao pursued and defeated them at Tangyin.

sentences.zh: 七年，捻東走，扼晉州西北路，折而南。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Nian fled east, blocked the northwest road at Jizhou, then turned south.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the Nian fled east, blocked the northwest road at Jizhou, then turned south.

sentences.zh: 諸將謀逐之，曜謂賊勢未蹙遽南奔，必有深謀。

translations.literal: The generals planned to chase them; Yao said that with their strength not yet pressed, a sudden southward flight must hide deeper design.
translations.idiomatic: Generals planned to chase them; Yao said a sudden southward flight while still strong must hide deeper design.

sentences.zh: 乃卷甲北趨，出其前二百里，至饒陽，果遇捻。

translations.literal: He then rolled up armor and rushed north, getting two hundred li ahead of them; reaching Raoyang, he indeed met the Nian.
translations.idiomatic: He rolled up armor and rushed north, getting two hundred li ahead; at Raoyang he met the Nian as expected.

sentences.zh: 捻不敢擊，錯愕去，潛渡滹沱。

translations.literal: The Nian dared not fight, fled in confusion, and secretly crossed the Hutuo River.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian dared not fight, fled in confusion, and secretly crossed the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 亟引兵至河干，未渡者殲焉。

translations.literal: He quickly led troops to the riverbank and wiped out those who had not yet crossed.
translations.idiomatic: He quickly reached the riverbank and wiped out those who had not yet crossed.

sentences.zh: 濟漳次清化，捻伐木為矛，又擊破之。

translations.literal: Crossing the Zhang River he halted at Qinghua; the Nian cut trees for spears, and he defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Zhang he halted at Qinghua; the Nian cut trees for spears and he defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 長驅滄州，劉松山軍運東，曜自南夾搫，捻披靡，追至臨邑。

translations.literal: Driving on to Cangzhou, Liu Songshan's army was east of the canal; Yao struck from the south in concert; the Nian scattered and he pursued to Lingyi.
translations.idiomatic: Driving to Cangzhou, he joined Liu Songshan east of the canal in a pincer; the Nian scattered and he pursued to Lingyi.

sentences.zh: 初，李鴻章遣郭松林自臨邑築牆，屬之馬頰河，虛西南以餌敵。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Hongzhang had sent Guo Songlin from Lingyi to build a wall reaching the Majia River, leaving the southwest open to bait the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Li Hongzhang had Guo Songlin build a wall from Lingyi to the Majia River, leaving the southwest open as bait.

sentences.zh: 逮曜馳至，捻不肯深入，走濟陽。

translations.literal: When Yao galloped up, the Nian would not advance deep and fled to Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao arrived the Nian would not advance deep and fled to Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 鴻章知計不售，使曜趨武定，遇捻於濱州，始敗退。

translations.literal: Hongzhang knew the plan had failed and sent Yao toward Wuding; meeting the Nian at Binzhou, they were at last beaten back.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhang saw the plan had failed and sent Yao toward Wuding; at Binzhou the Nian were at last beaten back.

sentences.zh: 會天大雨，河暴漲，諸將慮捻東逸，謀扼徒駭河。

translations.literal: Just then heavy rain fell and the river surged; the generals feared the Nian would escape east and planned to block the Tuhai River.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rain fell and the river surged; generals feared an eastern escape and planned to block the Tuhai River.

sentences.zh: 曜自博平守至東昌，誘捻入河套，與慶合擊之。

translations.literal: Yao held from Boping to Dongchang, lured the Nian into the river bend, and with Qing struck them together.
translations.idiomatic: Yao held from Boping to Dongchang, lured the Nian into the river bend, and with Qing struck together.

sentences.zh: 捻眾陷泥淖中，死者枕藉。

translations.literal: The Nian masses sank in mud; the dead lay piled.
translations.idiomatic: The Nian sank in mud; the dead lay piled.

sentences.zh: 自是總愚不復能軍，逐北茌平，殺其黨且盡，騎能屬者十餘人耳。

translations.literal: From then on Zongyu could no longer keep an army together; pursued north to Chiping, his followers were nearly all killed; only a dozen or so riders could still follow.
translations.idiomatic: Zongyu could no longer hold an army; pursued to Chiping his followers were nearly all killed; only a dozen riders remained.

sentences.zh: 總愚自度不得脫，乃沉於河。

translations.literal: Zongyu saw he could not escape and drowned himself in the river.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing no escape, Zongyu drowned himself in the river.

sentences.zh: 論功，賞黃馬褂，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: For merit he was awarded a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he received a yellow riding jacket and a hereditary Cavalry Commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔趣左宗棠赴涇州，責金順以邊外事，命曜自古城西進為後路，軍次蘭扇，破回於察漠綽爾，又敗之紅柳樹，阿拉善圍解。

translations.literal: In the eighth year orders urgently summoned Zuo Zongtang to Jingzhou; Jin Shun was charged with frontier affairs; Yao was ordered to advance west from Gucheng as rear guard; the army halted at Lanshan, defeated Muslims at Chamochuo'er, again defeated them at Hongliushu, and the Alashan siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Zuo Zongtang was urgently summoned to Jingzhou and Jin Shun charged with frontier affairs; Yao advanced west from Gucheng as rear guard, defeated Muslims at Chamochuo'er and Hongliushu, and lifted the Alashan siege.

sentences.zh: 抵纏金，诇知寧夏西岸自石嘴山至中衛，陝回麕集。

translations.literal: Reaching Chanjin, he learned that from Shizuishan to Zhongwei on the west bank of Ningxia, Shaanxi Muslims had gathered thickly.
translations.idiomatic: At Chanjin he learned Shaanxi Muslims had massed from Shizuishan to Zhongwei on Ningxia's west bank.

sentences.zh: 遣將要擊之，回遁走。

translations.literal: He sent generals to intercept them; the Muslims fled.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals to intercept; the Muslims fled.

sentences.zh: 金順赴沙金託海與議進兵事，方將鼓行而西，而寧夏降回复叛，圍郡城。

translations.literal: Jin Shun went to Shajintuohai to discuss advancing west; just as they were about to march, surrendered Ningxia Muslims rebelled again and besieged the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun went to Shajintuohai to plan the western advance; just as they were to march, surrendered Ningxia Muslims rebelled and besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 遂倍道應赴，敗之城下。

translations.literal: Yao then rushed by forced marches to relieve them and defeated the rebels below the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yao rushed by forced marches, relieved the city, and defeated the rebels below the walls.

sentences.zh: 俄而陝回入賀蘭山。

translations.literal: Before long Shaanxi Muslims entered Helan Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shaanxi Muslims entered Helan Mountain.

sentences.zh: 曜赴河北，南破漢渠集，圍納中閘，拔其壘，與金順夾渠而軍，殲守賊殆盡。

translations.literal: Yao went to the north of the river, broke Hanquji in the south, besieged Nazhong Gate, captured its fort, and with Jin Shun camped on both sides of the canal, nearly wiping out the garrison rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Yao crossed to the north bank, took Hanquji, besieged Nazhong Gate, captured its fort, and with Jin Shun flanked the canal, nearly wiping out the garrison rebels.

sentences.zh: 會金積撫局成，通昌、通貴乞款附，獨王家甿不下。

translations.literal: Just as the Jinjibao pacification was concluded, Tongchang and Tonggui begged to submit; only Wang Jiamang would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: As the Jinjibao pacification concluded, Tongchang and Tonggui submitted; only Wang Jiamang held out.

sentences.zh: 曜怒，破其堡，屠之。

translations.literal: Yao in anger broke his fort and slaughtered the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Yao stormed the fort and slaughtered the inhabitants.

sentences.zh: 攻剋納家寨，河西無悍寇。

translations.literal: He attacked and took Najia Stockade; west of the river there were no fierce rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He took Najia Stockade; no fierce rebels remained west of the river.

sentences.zh: 詔屯之，兼顧阿拉善旗。

translations.literal: Orders placed him in garrison and also to watch over the Alashan Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Orders garrisoned him there and charged him with watching the Alashan Banner.

sentences.zh: 是為寧郡河北之師。

translations.literal: This was the Ning Prefecture north-of-river force.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Ning Prefecture force north of the river.

sentences.zh: 九年，授廣東提督，仍留軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Guangdong provincial military commander but remained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Guangdong provincial military commander but remained with the army.

sentences.zh: 明年，加雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: The next year he was given a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he received a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank.

sentences.zh: 白彥虎據肅州，徐佔彪攻弗克，請益師，宗棠檄曜頓金積助之。

translations.literal: Bai Yanhu held Suzhou; Xu Zhanbiao attacked without success and asked for reinforcements; Zuo Zongtang ordered Yao to encamp at Jinjibao to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Yanhu held Suzhou; Xu Zhanbiao failed to take it and asked for reinforcements; Zuo ordered Yao to camp at Jinjibao to help.

sentences.zh: 上以為勇，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: The throne considered him brave and awarded double-peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: The throne judged him brave and awarded double-peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 十三年，彥虎亡命出嘉峪關，窟烏魯木齊，哈密城南北附之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Yanhu fled beyond Jiayuguan and lurked at Urumqi; north and south of Hami city submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Yanhu fled beyond Jiayuguan and lurked at Urumqi; areas north and south of Hami submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 俄羅斯方擁伊犁，巴里坤且岌岌。

translations.literal: Russia was then holding Ili and Barkul was in peril.
translations.idiomatic: Russia held Ili and Barkul was in peril.

sentences.zh: 朝命總防討，亟援哈密。

translations.literal: The court ordered overall defense and suppression and urgently sent aid to Hami.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered general defense and urgent aid to Hami.

sentences.zh: 曜剋日出關，師行乏水草，絕幕二千餘裡，運餽艱阻，於是議立屯田。

translations.literal: Yao set out beyond the pass on schedule; the march lacked water and grass across more than two thousand li of desert; transport of supplies was hard; thus garrison farming was proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yao marched beyond the pass on schedule; the two-thousand-li desert march lacked water and forage and supply was hard, so garrison farming was proposed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，出屯，大興水利，墾荒地二萬畝，歲獲數万石濟軍。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he went out to farm, greatly developed irrigation, reclaimed twenty thousand mu of wasteland, and harvested tens of thousands of shi each year to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he established farms, developed irrigation, reclaimed twenty thousand mu, and harvested tens of thousands of shi yearly for the army.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，師規南路，西取七克騰木、闢展及魯克沁台、勝金台、哈拉和卓城，降纏回萬餘，遂復吐魯番。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu the army planned the southern route, took Qiketengmu, Pizhan, and Lukqintai, Shengjintai, and Halahuo City in the west, accepted the surrender of more than ten thousand Taranchis, and recovered Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 the army took the southern route, captured Qiketengmu, Pizhan, Lukqintai, Shengjintai, and Halahuo City, accepted more than ten thousand Taranchi surrenders, and recovered Turfan.

sentences.zh: 明年，拔烏魯木齊，彥虎遁入俄。

translations.literal: The next year Urumqi was taken and Yanhu fled into Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Urumqi fell and Yanhu fled into Russia.

sentences.zh: 俄歸伊犁，宗棠疏薦堪重任。

translations.literal: When Russia returned Ili, Zuo Zongtang memorialized recommending Yao as fit for heavy responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: When Russia returned Ili, Zuo memorialized recommending Yao for heavy responsibility.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔贊軍事，命移駐喀什噶爾，兼轄西四城，籌善後，所至創立義塾。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was ordered to assist in military affairs, move headquarters to Kashgar, also govern the four western cities, plan postwar settlement, and wherever he went he founded charity schools.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was ordered to assist in military affairs, move to Kashgar, govern the four western cities, plan reconstruction, and found charity schools wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 回夙獷噬，至是頗聞弦誦聲。

translations.literal: The Muslims had long been fierce; by now the sound of recitation was often heard.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims had long been fierce; by now the sound of study was often heard in their settlements.

sentences.zh: 十年，入關防直北，賞巡撫銜，敘邊功，晉秩頭品。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he entered the pass to defend north Zhili, was given a governor's title, was credited for frontier merit, and was promoted to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he entered the pass to defend north Zhili, received a governor's title, was credited for frontier service, and rose to first rank.

sentences.zh: 明年，除廣西巡撫，未行，董所部治都城河，加尚書銜。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed governor of Guangxi; before departing he was put in charge of his troops to manage the capital river works and given a minister's title.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed Guangxi governor; before leaving he was charged with capital river works and given ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 旋命赴山東勘河，喻歲至壽張，調撫山東。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to Shandong to survey the river; within a year he reached Shouzhang and was transferred as governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to survey Shandong's rivers; within a year he reached Shouzhang and was made governor of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 東省河患日深，曜蒞任，首重河工，以黃、運並淤，非總濬通海不為功。

translations.literal: The eastern province's river disasters grew daily; when Yao took office he put river works first, holding that with both the Yellow River and Grand Canal silted, only dredging through to the sea would suffice.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong's river crisis worsened daily; Yao made river works his first priority, arguing that with both the Yellow River and Grand Canal silted, only a full dredge to the sea would do.

sentences.zh: 時王家圈等處先後漫口，先議疏濬海口，挑淤培埝，並增築徒駭河兩岸堤工，以防氾濫，然後挑挖全河，參用西法，以機船疏運。

translations.literal: At this time breaches at Wangjiaquan and elsewhere had opened in succession; first they planned to dredge the estuary, remove silt and raise embankments, and also strengthen dikes on both banks of the Tuhai River against flooding, then dredge the whole river, using Western methods with machine dredgers on the canal.
translations.idiomatic: Breaches at Wangjiaquan and elsewhere had opened in succession; the plan was to dredge the estuary, raise embankments, strengthen Tuhai dikes, then dredge the whole river using Western machine dredgers on the canal.

sentences.zh: 凡南北兩岸堤埝口門，一律籌辦。

translations.literal: All outlet gates and embankments on both north and south banks were to be handled uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: All outlet gates and embankments on both banks were to be handled uniformly.

sentences.zh: 疏上，皆從之。

translations.literal: When the memorial went up, all was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved in full.

sentences.zh: 又先後築王家圈、姚家口、張村、殷河大寨、西紙坊、高家套各決口，​​復改濬韓家垣，以洩尾閭，莫不身親其事，計一歲中奔走河上幾三百日。

translations.literal: He also in succession closed breaches at Wangjiaquan, Yaojiakou, Zhangcun, Yinhe Dazhai, Xizhifang, and Gaojiatao, and again dredged Hanjiayuan to drain the tail reach; in none of this did he fail to attend personally, spending nearly three hundred days on the river in one year.
translations.idiomatic: He closed breaches at Wangjiaquan, Yaojiakou, Zhangcun, Yinhe Dazhai, Xizhifang, and Gaojiatao, dredged Hanjiayuan to drain the tail reach, and personally spent nearly three hundred days on the river that year.

sentences.zh: 有言河務者，雖布衣末僚，皆延致諮詢，唯恐失之。

translations.literal: Anyone who spoke on river affairs, even a commoner or low clerk, he invited and consulted, fearing to miss anything.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone with knowledge of river affairs, even commoners or junior clerks, he summoned for consultation lest anything be missed.

sentences.zh: 民或遇災，常籌粟賑濟。

translations.literal: When the people met disaster he often raised grain for relief.
translations.idiomatic: When the people suffered disaster he often raised grain for relief.

sentences.zh: 復建海岱書院於青州，葺洙泗書院於曲阜，士民德之。

translations.literal: He also rebuilt the Haidai Academy at Qingzhou and restored the Zhusi Academy at Qufu; scholars and commoners were grateful.
translations.idiomatic: He rebuilt the Haidai Academy at Qingzhou and restored the Zhusi Academy at Qufu; scholars and commoners were grateful.

sentences.zh: 十四年，被命襄辦海軍。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to assist in managing the navy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to assist in managing the navy.

sentences.zh: 明年，晉太子少保，命會閱南、北洋海軍。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and ordered to inspect the southern and northern Beiyang fleets.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and ordered to inspect the southern and northern Beiyang fleets.

sentences.zh: 至煙台，聞台灣巡撫劉銘傳稱疾去，則抗章請行，優詔答之。

translations.literal: Reaching Yantai, he heard Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan had resigned citing illness; he memorialized against leaving and received an approving edict.
translations.idiomatic: At Yantai he learned Taiwan Governor Liu Mingchuan had resigned citing illness; he memorialized to take the post and received an approving edict.

sentences.zh: 十七年，方駐河干督工，疽發於背，回省就醫，遽卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, while stationed on the river supervising works, an abscess broke out on his back; he returned to the province for treatment and suddenly died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, while supervising river works, an abscess broke out on his back; he returned for treatment and died suddenly.

sentences.zh: 疾革時，猶貽書鴻章，首言山東為北洋門戶，亟宜治砲台備不虞；

translations.literal: At the height of his illness he still wrote Hongzhang, first saying Shandong was the Beiyang gateway and fortifications should urgently be built against the unexpected;
translations.idiomatic: At death's door he still wrote Li Hongzhang, first urging that Shandong, gateway to the Beiyang, needed fortifications against the unexpected;

sentences.zh: 次言新疆軍糈，部令裁營清釐，緩不濟急，恐失信外域，貽君父憂。

translations.literal: next saying that for Xinjiang army grain the ministry's order to cut camps and clear accounts was too slow for urgent needs, fearing loss of trust in the borderlands and worry for the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: next warning that the ministry's order to cut Xinjiang camps and clear accounts was too slow for urgent needs and risked losing frontier trust and troubling the throne.

sentences.zh: 遺疏入，上震悼，贈太子太保，諡勤果，予建祠。

translations.literal: When his final memorial arrived the throne was deeply grieved; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, titled Qinguo, and granted a memorial shrine.
translations.idiomatic: When his final memorial arrived the throne mourned deeply, posthumously made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, titled him Qinguo, and ordered a memorial shrine.

sentences.zh: 曜魁梧倜儻，自少從戎，不廢書史，字法橅顏平原，書疏雅馴猶餘事。

translations.literal: Yao was tall and free-spirited; from youth in the army he did not abandon books and history; his calligraphy modeled Yan Zhenqing; elegant letters were still side matters.
translations.idiomatic: Tall and free-spirited, Yao never abandoned books despite a lifetime in arms; his calligraphy followed Yan Zhenqing, and polished letters were the least of his accomplishments.

sentences.zh: 嘗鐫「目不識丁」四字印，佩以自勵。

translations.literal: He once carved a seal with the four characters "cannot recognize a single character" and wore it to encourage himself.
translations.idiomatic: He carved a seal reading "cannot recognize a single character" and wore it to spur himself on.

sentences.zh: 寧夏平，築樓面黃河，對賀蘭山，顏曰「河聲岳色」，日嘯詠其中，人謂有羊叔子登峴風。

translations.literal: When Ningxia was pacified he built a tower facing the Yellow River opposite Helan Mountain, inscribed "River Sound, Mountain Color," and daily chanted within; people said it had the air of Yang Hu ascending Xian.
translations.idiomatic: After Ningxia was pacified he built a tower facing the Yellow River with Helan Mountain beyond, inscribed "River Sound, Mountain Color," and daily chanted there; people likened it to Yang Hu on Xian Mountain.

sentences.zh: 居官垂四十年，不言治產事，性尚義，所得廉俸輒散盡。

translations.literal: In office nearly forty years he never spoke of managing property; by nature he valued righteousness and spent his honest salary as fast as it came.
translations.idiomatic: In nearly forty years of office he never spoke of building wealth; he valued righteousness and spent his salary as fast as it came.

sentences.zh: 尤禮賢下士，士爭往歸之。

translations.literal: He especially honored the worthy and humbled himself before scholars; scholars competed to join him.
translations.idiomatic: He especially honored scholars and humbled himself before them; men of letters flocked to him.

sentences.zh: 其修道路，開廠局，精製造，凡有利於民者，靡不畢舉。

translations.literal: In repairing roads, opening factories, and refining manufacture—whatever benefited the people—nothing was left undone.
translations.idiomatic: Roads, factories, manufactures—whatever benefited the people, he undertook it.

sentences.zh: 死之日，百姓巷哭失聲，喪歸，且傾城以送。

translations.literal: On the day he died the people wept aloud in the lanes; when the coffin returned the whole city turned out to send him off.
translations.idiomatic: On the day he died people wept in the lanes; when the coffin returned the whole city turned out.

sentences.zh: 以兩世職並為男爵，子端本襲，官南韶連道。

translations.literal: His two hereditary ranks were combined into a barony; his son Duanben inherited and served as intendant of Nan-Shao-Lian Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His two hereditary ranks were combined into a barony; his son Duanben inherited and served as Nan-Shao-Lian intendant.

sentences.zh: 劉典，字克盦，湖南寧鄉人。

translations.literal: Liu Dian, courtesy name Ke'an, was a native of Ningxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dian, styled Ke'an, came from Ningxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 少伏溈山，與羅澤南友善，以學相期許。

translations.literal: In youth he lived on Mount Wei and was friendly with Luo Zemin, encouraging each other in study.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he lived on Mount Wei and befriended Luo Zemin, encouraging each other in study.

sentences.zh: 齋匪亂，集眾保鄉邑，敘訓導。

translations.literal: When the Taiping bandits rose he gathered people to defend the township and was recorded as instructor.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taiping rebels rose he gathered militia to defend his township and was recorded as instructor.

sentences.zh: 參左宗棠戎幕，轉戰江西。

translations.literal: He joined Zuo Zongtang's military staff and fought through Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Zuo Zongtang's staff and fought through Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 善察形勢，嘗輕騎詗敵營，夜率所部劫殺，數獲奇捷。

translations.literal: Skilled at reading terrain, he often rode lightly to reconnoiter enemy camps and by night led his unit in raids, repeatedly winning strange victories.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at reading terrain, he often reconnoitered enemy camps by light cavalry and led night raids for repeated surprise victories.

sentences.zh: 李秀成欲以長圍困宗棠，斷曾軍糧運，典敗浮梁，又破之樂平，婺源餉道始達祁門。

translations.literal: Li Xiucheng wished to use a long encirclement to trap Zuo Zongtang and cut Zeng's army grain transport; Dian defeated him at Fuliang and again at Leping, and the Wuyuan supply route finally reached Qimen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiucheng tried to encircle Zuo and cut Zeng's supply line; Dian defeated him at Fuliang and Leping, and the Wuyuan route finally reached Qimen.

sentences.zh: 積勳至直隸州知州。

translations.literal: For accumulated merit he reached prefect of Zhili Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated merit he rose to prefect of Zhili Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗棠撫浙，典以偏師討衢、嚴。

translations.literal: When Zuo Zongtang pacified Zhejiang, Dian led a detached force against Qu and Yan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo pacified Zhejiang, Dian led a detached force against Quzhou and Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 同治改元，破馬金街，進克遂安，遷知府。

translations.literal: At the change to Tongzhi he broke Majin Street, advanced and took Suian, and was transferred to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: At the Tongzhi change he broke Majin Street, took Suian, and was promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 擊花園港，李世賢遁，超授浙江按察使。

translations.literal: Attacking Huayuan Harbor, Li Shixian fled; he was exceptionally appointed Zhejiang surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Huayuan Harbor he drove off Li Shixian and was exceptionally appointed Zhejiang surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 世賢謀據金華，分黨擾龍遊、湯溪、蘭谿，眾號數十萬。

translations.literal: Shixian planned to hold Jinhua and sent parties to harass Longyou, Tangxi, and Lanxi; their numbers were said to reach several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian planned to hold Jinhua and sent parties to harass Longyou, Tangxi, and Lanxi; their numbers were said to reach hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 典還軍援衢，力據上游，悉夷東南北寇壘。

translations.literal: Dian returned his army to aid Qu, firmly held the upper reaches, and destroyed rebel forts east, south, and north.
translations.idiomatic: Dian returned to aid Quzhou, held the upper reaches firmly, and destroyed rebel forts on every side.

sentences.zh: 明年，收蘭谿，諸軍亦下三城，浙東告寧。

translations.literal: The next year Lanxi was recovered and the other armies also took three cities; eastern Zhejiang was declared calm.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Lanxi fell and other armies took three cities; eastern Zhejiang was declared calm.

sentences.zh: 宗棠規杭州，策江、皖邊圉安，方可一意進取。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang planned for Hangzhou, reasoning that only when the Jiang-Anhui border was secure could he advance with single purpose.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo planned for Hangzhou, reasoning that the Jiang-Anhui border must be secure before he could advance with single purpose.

sentences.zh: 乃令典將五千人，道嚴出皖南。

translations.literal: He then ordered Dian to lead five thousand men out of southern Anhui by way of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Dian to lead five thousand men out of southern Anhui through Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 當是時，新復郡縣糧饋不屬，典持印票空文，向民間貸糧，遇寇遮擊，而屯溪，而黟縣，所風靡。

translations.literal: At this time newly recovered prefectures and counties lacked grain supplies; Dian carried blank stamped tickets and borrowed grain from the people; when bandits blocked the way he swept through Tunxi and Yixian.
translations.idiomatic: Newly recovered counties lacked grain; Dian carried blank stamped tickets and borrowed from the people, sweeping through Tunxi and Yixian when bandits blocked the way.

sentences.zh: 民望典軍如時雨，以故壺漿塞塗。

translations.literal: The people looked on Dian's army like timely rain; therefore pots of drink filled the road.
translations.idiomatic: The people welcomed Dian's army like rain in drought; pots of drink filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 沈葆楨謂其截擊寇眾，功不在克省城下。

translations.literal: Shen Baozhen said his intercepting rebel masses was a merit not less than taking the provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Baozhen said intercepting rebel masses was a merit not less than taking the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 江、皖既平，賜號阿爾剛阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When Jiang and Anhui were pacified he was granted the title A'ergang Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiang and Anhui were pacified he received the title A'ergang Baturn.

sentences.zh: 其秋，父憂歸。

translations.literal: That autumn he returned home for his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn he returned home for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔起督師，典募新軍八千，次貴溪。

translations.literal: In the third year he was recalled by decree to command troops; Dian raised eight thousand new troops and halted at Guixi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was recalled to command; Dian raised eight thousand new troops and halted at Guixi.

sentences.zh: 世賢入閩陷漳州，汪海洋亦陷龍巖，勢复熾。

translations.literal: Shixian entered Fujian and took Zhangzhou; Wang Haiyang also took Longyan; their power revived.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian entered Fujian and took Zhangzhou; Wang Haiyang took Longyan; rebel strength revived.

sentences.zh: 典進汀、連，號西路軍。

translations.literal: Dian advanced through Ting and Lian and was styled the Western Route Army.
translations.idiomatic: Dian advanced through Tingzhou and Lianzhou as the Western Route Army.

sentences.zh: 遇海洋，新軍輕進，敗績，還保連城。

translations.literal: Meeting Haiyang, the new army advanced rashly, suffered defeat, and fell back to defend Liancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting Haiyang, the new army advanced rashly, was defeated, and fell back to Liancheng.

sentences.zh: 四年，再戰，斬寇萬餘，進复龍巖、南靖。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he fought again, beheaded more than ten thousand bandits, and advanced to recover Longyan and Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he fought again, killed more than ten thousand rebels, and recovered Longyan and Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 世賢為高連升所蹙，奔粵，宗棠麾下壯士騎從者八百餘人馳之。

translations.literal: Shixian was pressed by Gao Liansheng and fled to Guangdong; more than eight hundred mounted veterans under Zuo Zongtang galloped after him.
translations.idiomatic: Shixian, pressed by Gao Liansheng, fled to Guangdong; more than eight hundred of Zuo's mounted veterans galloped after him.

sentences.zh: 典至南雄，語其將黃少春曰：「尾寇而追，非計也。

translations.literal: Dian reached Nanxiong and said to his general Huang Shaochun, "Pursuing the tail of the bandits is not the plan.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanxiong Dian told Huang Shaochun: "Pursuing the rebels' tail is not the plan.

sentences.zh: 寇返奔亟，必不久據嘉應，當走粵、閩邊。

translations.literal: The bandits are fleeing back in haste and will not long hold Jiaying; they will run toward the Guang-Fujian border.
translations.idiomatic: They are fleeing in haste and will not long hold Jiaying; they will run toward the Guang-Fujian border.

sentences.zh: 左軍孤，遇寇必不支。」

translations.literal: Zuo's army is isolated; if it meets the bandits it cannot hold."
translations.idiomatic: Zuo's army is isolated; if it meets the rebels it cannot hold."

sentences.zh: 乃持二旬糧，取道大嶺脊，晨夜應赴，抵大埔，先宗棠一日，遂會師复嘉應，晉二品服，予世職。

translations.literal: He then carried twenty days' grain, took the route over the Great Ridge spine, marched day and night to respond, reached Dabu one day before Zuo Zongtang, then joined forces to recover Jiaying, was promoted to second-rank dress, and given a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: He carried twenty days' grain over the Great Ridge, marched day and night, reached Dabu a day before Zuo, joined forces to recover Jiaying, was promoted to second rank, and given a hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 事寧，乞歸省。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled he asked to return home.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were settled he asked to return home.

sentences.zh: 五年，宗棠徙督陝、甘，起典甘肅按察使，旋賜三品卿，佐軍事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Zuo Zongtang moved to governor of Shaanxi and Gansu; Dian was raised to Gansu surveillance commissioner and soon given third-rank vice minister title to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Zuo became governor of Shaanxi and Gansu; Dian was raised to Gansu surveillance commissioner, given third-rank vice minister title, and assigned to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 典自紫荊關入，值捻竄渭北，乃駐潼關，偪渭而軍，扼其南渡。

translations.literal: Dian entered through Zijing Pass; just as the Nian raided north of the Wei River he encamped at Tong Pass, pressed the Wei with his army, and blocked their southward crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Entering through Zijing Pass as Nian raided north of the Wei, he encamped at Tong Pass, pressed the Wei, and blocked their southward crossing.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered acting governor of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was named acting governor of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 初，宗棠援晉，以徵回事屬典。

translations.literal: At first when Zuo Zongtang aided Shanxi, matters of the western campaign belonged to Dian.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo first aided Shanxi, the western campaign fell to Dian.

sentences.zh: 典以關中戎備寡，調提督周達武壁隴、汧顧後路。

translations.literal: Dian, because Guanzhong's military preparedness was thin, moved Brigade General Zhou Dawu to hold Long and Qian and guard the rear route.
translations.idiomatic: Finding Guanzhong thinly defended, Dian moved Brigade General Zhou Dawu to hold Long and Qian and guard the rear.

sentences.zh: 至總前敵師幹，則舉蔣益澧自代，朝旨弗許。

translations.literal: When it came to overall front command he recommended Jiang Yili to replace himself; the court would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: For overall front command he recommended Jiang Yili to replace him; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 尋復有是命。

translations.literal: Before long the same order came again.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the same order came again.

sentences.zh: 典遂進駐三原，調度諸軍，軍大振。

translations.literal: Dian then advanced headquarters to Sanyuan, coordinated the armies, and the army greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: Dian advanced headquarters to Sanyuan, coordinated the armies, and morale revived sharply.

sentences.zh: 明年，與宗棠定三路剿回策。

translations.literal: The next year he and Zuo Zongtang fixed a three-route strategy to suppress the Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he and Zuo fixed a three-route strategy against the Muslims.

sentences.zh: 已，复念民事，重入省，治善後，集流亡，舉屯牧，卹艱戹，革差徭。
