translations.literal: Soon he again turned to civil affairs, re-entered the province, handled postwar settlement, gathered the displaced, promoted garrison farming, relieved hardship, and reformed corvée levies.
translations.idiomatic: He then turned to civil affairs, re-entered the province, resettled refugees, promoted garrison farming, relieved hardship, and reformed corvée.

sentences.zh: 又以其時濬鄭白舊渠，關中漸喁喁望治矣。

translations.literal: At that time the Zheng-Bai old canal was being dredged and Guanzhong gradually looked toward good government.
translations.idiomatic: As the Zheng-Bai old canal was dredged, Guanzhong gradually looked toward good government.

sentences.zh: 惟銳然以減餉自任，諸軍舊欠各餉，十給其七，士卒不無怨望雲。

translations.literal: Only he sharply took cutting pay upon himself; for old arrears owed the armies he paid seven tenths; the soldiers were not without resentment.
translations.idiomatic: He sharply cut army pay on his own authority, paying only seven tenths of old arrears; the soldiers resented it.

sentences.zh: 又明年，再乞歸省。

translations.literal: The year after next he again asked to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he again asked to return home.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，復命佐宗棠軍務，典辭以疾，詔罷其行。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was again ordered to assist Zuo Zongtang in military affairs; Dian declined on grounds of illness and the decree canceled his departure.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he was again ordered to assist Zuo; Dian declined on grounds of illness and the decree was canceled.

sentences.zh: 時譚鍾麟督西征餉事，力言司左軍後路非典莫屬。

translations.literal: At this time Tan Zhonglin supervised western expedition supplies and strongly argued that managing the Hunan Army rear route was Dian's alone to fill.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Zhonglin, supervising western expedition supplies, argued strongly that managing the Hunan Army rear was uniquely Dian's role.

sentences.zh: 朝旨乃趣赴甘，於是典三起討賊矣。

translations.literal: Imperial orders then urgently sent him to Gansu; thus Dian rose a third time to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders urgently sent him to Gansu; thus Dian took the field against rebels for the third time.

sentences.zh: 二年，至蘭州，宗棠以善後畀之。

translations.literal: In the second year he reached Lanzhou; Zuo Zongtang entrusted postwar settlement to him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he reached Lanzhou and Zuo entrusted postwar settlement to him.

sentences.zh: 凡整軍節餉，以及生聚教誨，有裨於民生久遠者，咸殫心厥事。

translations.literal: In reorganizing the army, economizing supplies, and in gathering people, teaching, and whatever benefited people's livelihood for the long term, he devoted his whole heart.
translations.idiomatic: In reorganizing troops, economizing supplies, resettling people, and teaching—whatever benefited long-term livelihood—he gave his whole heart.

sentences.zh: 至關外平定，亦嘗指陳方略，贊畫功多。

translations.literal: When the lands beyond the pass were pacified he also often outlined strategy and his planning merit was great.
translations.idiomatic: When the lands beyond the pass were pacified he often outlined strategy and contributed greatly to planning.

sentences.zh: 經營新疆凡三年，卒於軍次。

translations.literal: Managing Xinjiang for three years in all, he died in camp.
translations.idiomatic: After three years managing Xinjiang he died in camp.

sentences.zh: 詔視侍郎賜卹，諡果敏，予江、浙、陝、甘建祠。

translations.literal: He was ordered treated as a vice minister for mourning rites, posthumously titled Guomin, and granted memorial shrines in Jiang, Zhe, Shaan, and Gan.
translations.idiomatic: He was mourned at vice minister rank, posthumously titled Guomin, and granted memorial shrines in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 典秉性清嚴，貴後自奉儉約。

translations.literal: Dian's nature was stern and pure; after rising in rank he kept himself frugal.
translations.idiomatic: Dian was stern and pure by nature; after rising in rank he lived frugally.

sentences.zh: 楊昌濬嘗詣典，環堵蕭然，一如寒素，寓書宗棠共稱之。

translations.literal: Yang Changjun once visited Dian; the bare room was utterly plain, like a poor scholar's; he wrote Zuo Zongtang and they praised him together.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Changjun once found his rooms bare as a poor scholar's; he wrote Zuo Zongtang and they praised him together.

sentences.zh: 弟倬雲，少隨典讀書長沙。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhuo Yun, in youth followed Dian to study in Changsha.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhuo Yun studied with him in Changsha as a youth.

sentences.zh: 典主鄉團，倬雲以廩生治軍書。

translations.literal: When Dian led the local militia, Zhuo Yun as a stipend student managed military documents.
translations.idiomatic: When Dian led local militia, Zhuo Yun, a stipend student, managed military documents.

sentences.zh: 從援浙，領偏軍，戰常陷堅。

translations.literal: Following the relief of Zhejiang he led a detached force and in battle often pierced the hardest positions.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhejiang campaign he led a detached force and often broke the hardest lines.

sentences.zh: 李、汪二酋奔贛，扼臨江使不得西，敘知縣。

translations.literal: When the Li and Wang chieftains fled to Gan, he blocked Linjiang to keep them from going west and was recorded as county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: When Li and Wang fled to Gan he blocked Linjiang to keep them from going west and was recorded as county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 龍巖既复，會糧罄，軍士乏食，為貸鄰邑以濟，民德之，建生祠。

translations.literal: After Longyan was recovered, supplies ran out and soldiers lacked food; he borrowed from neighboring counties to relieve them; the people were grateful and built a living shrine.
translations.idiomatic: After Longyan was recovered supplies ran out; he borrowed from neighboring counties to feed the troops; the people built a living shrine in gratitude.

sentences.zh: 將軍庫克吉泰檄赴陝，值連升營哥匪謀變，戕主帥。

translations.literal: General Kukejitai ordered him to Shaanxi; just as Liansheng's camp plotted mutiny among brother-bandits and killed the commander.
translations.idiomatic: General Kukejitai ordered him to Shaanxi just as Liansheng's camp plotted mutiny and killed the commander.

sentences.zh: 倬雲馳入，殲其渠，餘眾悉定，再遷知府。

translations.literal: Zhuo Yun galloped in, wiped out the ringleaders, and the rest were all settled; he was twice promoted to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo Yun galloped in, wiped out the ringleaders, settled the rest, and was twice promoted to prefect.

sentences.zh: 時慶陽大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: At this time Qingyang suffered great famine and people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyang then suffered great famine and people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 倬雲興屯政，立賑局，流民懷集。

translations.literal: Zhuo Yun promoted garrison farming policy, established relief bureaus, and refugees gathered under his care.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo Yun promoted garrison farming, established relief bureaus, and refugees gathered under his care.

sentences.zh: 假歸，適會匪亂，連下龍陽、益陽，詔用道員。

translations.literal: On leave home, just as local bandits rose, he successively took Longyang and Yiyang; he was ordered to intendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: On leave when local bandits rose he took Longyang and Yiyang in succession and was ordered to intendant rank.

sentences.zh: 越法事起，赴閩綜營務，署按察使。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose he went to Fujian to oversee camp affairs and served as acting surveillance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose he went to Fujian to oversee camps and served as acting surveillance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以捕海盜名，晉二品秩，授汀漳龍道。

translations.literal: Famous for capturing pirates, he was promoted to second rank and appointed intendant of Ting-Zhang-Long Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Famous for capturing pirates, he rose to second rank and was appointed intendant of Ting-Zhang-Long Circuit.

sentences.zh: 興蠶桑，建書院，周恤堤防諸政，次第畢舉。

translations.literal: Sericulture, academies, and dikes and other policies benefiting the people were undertaken in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Sericulture, academies, dikes, and other policies for the people were undertaken in turn.

sentences.zh: 尋謝病歸。

translations.literal: Soon he resigned citing illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he resigned citing illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died; mourning rites followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he died; mourning rites followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 金順，字和甫，伊爾根覺羅氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人，世居吉林。

translations.literal: Jin Shun, courtesy name Hefu, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner, long resident in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun, styled Hefu, of the Irgen Gioro clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner from Jilin.

sentences.zh: 少孤貧，事繼母孝。

translations.literal: Orphaned young and poor, he served his stepmother filially.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young and poor, he served his stepmother filially.

sentences.zh: 初，從征山東，授驍騎校。

translations.literal: At first he followed the campaign in Shandong and was appointed daring cavalry commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He first campaigned in Shandong and was appointed daring cavalry commandant.

sentences.zh: 嗣從多隆阿援湖北，复黃梅，賜號圖爾格齊巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Later he followed Duolong'a to aid Hubei, recovered Huangmei, and was granted the title Tu'ergeqi Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Duolong'a to aid Hubei, recovered Huangmei, and received the title Tu'ergeqi Baturn.

sentences.zh: 移師安徽，克太湖。

translations.literal: Moving troops to Anhui he captured Taihu.
translations.idiomatic: Moving to Anhui he captured Taihu.

sentences.zh: 歷遷協領。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in succession to assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 掛車之役，將騎旅直搗中堅，當者輒靡。

translations.literal: In the Gache campaign he led cavalry straight at the center; whoever faced him was scattered.
translations.idiomatic: At Gache he led cavalry straight at the center; whoever faced him was scattered.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，從討陝回，連下羌白、王閣，賜頭品秩。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he followed the campaign against Shaanxi Muslims, successively took Qiangbai and Wangge, and was granted first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2 he campaigned against Shaanxi Muslims, took Qiangbai and Wangge, and received first rank.

sentences.zh: 复渡渭敗之零口。

translations.literal: He again crossed the Wei and defeated them at Lingkou.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed the Wei again and defeated them at Lingkou.

sentences.zh: 三年，漢南迴奔鳳翔，趨灃峪，擊卻之，授鑲黃旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: In the third year southern Shaanxi Muslims fled to Fengxiang and rushed toward Fengyu; he repelled them and was appointed deputy lieutenant general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year southern Shaanxi Muslims fled to Fengxiang and rushed Fengyu; he repelled them and was appointed deputy lieutenant general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 調西安，時粵寇集陝南，陝回導至灃河，金順御之，斬虜多。

translations.literal: Transferred to Xi'an; at this time Guangdong bandits gathered in southern Shaanxi and Shaanxi Muslims guided them to the Feng River; Jin Shun defended and beheaded many captives.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Xi'an, he met Guangdong bandits in southern Shaanxi guided by Shaanxi Muslims to the Feng River; Jin Shun defended and killed many.

sentences.zh: 回入鄠，傍山西走，复率馬隊邀擊敗之。

translations.literal: The Muslims entered Hu County and fled west along the hills; he again led cavalry to intercept and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims entered Hu County and fled west along the hills; he intercepted with cavalry and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 四年，攻寧夏南門，奪其砲台。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he attacked Ningxia's south gate and seized its batteries.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he attacked Ningxia's south gate and seized its batteries.

sentences.zh: 已，聞寇集黃河兩岸，率師分路進，陣斬其酋孫義保等，寇稍卻。

translations.literal: Soon hearing bandits gathered on both banks of the Yellow River, he led troops by separate routes; in battle he beheaded their chieftain Sun Yibao and others; the bandits slightly withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing bandits had gathered on both banks of the Yellow River, he advanced on separate routes, beheaded chieftain Sun Yibao and others, and the bandits withdrew.

sentences.zh: 明年，調寧夏副都統。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred deputy lieutenant general of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to deputy lieutenant general of Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 七年，复寧條梁。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again took Ningtiaoliang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he took Ningtiaoliang again.

sentences.zh: 聞榆林警，遂迎擊五龍山，大破之。

translations.literal: Hearing alarm at Yulin he went to meet them and at Wulongshan inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing alarm at Yulin he met the enemy and routed them at Wulongshan.

sentences.zh: 追至邊外禿尾河，馬隊忍寒裸涉，要之金雞灘，回大潰。

translations.literal: Pursuing to beyond the border at Tuwai River, cavalry endured cold and crossed naked; he intercepted them at Jinji Beach and the Muslims collapsed in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing beyond the border to Tuwai River, cavalry crossed naked in the cold, intercepted them at Jinji Beach, and the Muslims collapsed.

sentences.zh: 復遣將破之葭州。

translations.literal: He again sent generals to defeat them at Jiazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He sent generals to defeat them again at Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 八年，平綏德，朝旨以邊外事屬之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Suide was pacified; imperial orders placed frontier affairs under him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Suide was pacified; frontier affairs were placed under him.

sentences.zh: 四月，回犯花馬池，遣部將富勒琿馳救。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Muslims raided Huamachi; he sent Deputy Commander Fulehun to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Muslims raided Huamachi; he sent Deputy Commander Fulehun to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 回自烏拉爭渡，奔札薩旗。

translations.literal: The Muslims crossed the Wula River in contention and fled to the Zhasa Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims contested crossing the Wula River and fled to the Zhasa Banner.

sentences.zh: 金順自將出邊，回已遁。

translations.literal: Jin Shun personally led troops beyond the border; the Muslims had already fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun personally led troops beyond the border; the Muslims had already fled.

sentences.zh: 乃率師道札薩郡王答拉旗，自包頭迤西濟河而進。

translations.literal: He then led the army through Prince Dala's Banner of the Zhasa League, from Baotou winding west and crossing the river to advance.
translations.idiomatic: He led the army through Prince Dala's Zhasa Banner, from Baotou winding west and crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 會天酷暑，暫頓什巴爾台就水草，與張曜期會沙金託海。

translations.literal: Just as heaven was fiercely hot he temporarily halted at Shiba'ertai for water and grass and arranged to meet Zhang Yao at Shajintuohai.
translations.idiomatic: In fierce heat he halted at Shiba'ertai for water and grass and arranged to meet Zhang Yao at Shajintuohai.

sentences.zh: 七月，自中灘鼓行而西，而寧夏回复叛，乃兼程赴援，敗之於城外。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he marched west from Zhongtan; but Ningxia Muslims rebelled again; he rushed by forced marches to aid and defeated them outside the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he marched west from Zhongtan; Ningxia Muslims rebelled again; he rushed to aid and defeated them outside the city.

sentences.zh: 無何，甘回納萬元等迎戰漢渠，復與曜從東繞擊。

translations.literal: Before long Gansu Muslims Na Wanyuan and others came out to fight at Hanqu; he again with Yao struck from the east in a flanking attack.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Gansu Muslims led by Na Wanyuan fought at Hanqu; he and Yao struck again from the east.

sentences.zh: 回走納中閘，追至龍王廟南，悉拔其東南各壘，殲守賊殆盡。

translations.literal: The Muslims fled to Nazhong Gate; pursued to south of Longwang Temple all their southeast forts were taken and garrison rebels were nearly all wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims fled to Nazhong Gate; pursued to south of Longwang Temple all southeast forts fell and garrison rebels were nearly wiped out.

sentences.zh: 九年，金積撫局成，獨王家甿未下，率其弟連順分兵迎擊，數獲勝。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Jinjibao pacification was concluded; only Wang Jiamang had not submitted; he led his younger brother Lian Shun to divide forces and intercept, winning repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Jinjibao was pacified; only Wang Jiamang held out; he and his brother Lian Shun divided forces, intercepted, and won repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 自是連順無役不從，積勳至金州副都統。

translations.literal: From then on Lian Shun was in every campaign; for accumulated merit he reached deputy lieutenant general of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Lian Shun fought in every campaign and rose to deputy lieutenant general of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 金軍頗有聲，明年，克之，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: Jin's army had considerable reputation; the next year it was taken and he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's army had considerable reputation; the next year the fort fell and he received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 又與曜破納家寨，河西悍黨殲焉。

translations.literal: He again with Yao broke Najia Stockade; fierce bands west of the river were wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: He and Yao again broke Najia Stockade and wiped out fierce bands west of the river.

sentences.zh: 寧夏平，擢烏里雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: When Ningxia was pacified he was promoted general of Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningxia was pacified he was promoted general of Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 尋以赴鎮番未報，褫職，命即日赴肅州。

translations.literal: Soon because he had not reported arrival at Zhenfan he was stripped of office and ordered to go to Suzhou that very day.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for failing to report arrival at Zhenfan, he was stripped of office and ordered to Suzhou that day.

sentences.zh: 既至，頓北崖頭，奏調曜軍助擊。

translations.literal: On arrival he encamped at Beiyaitou and memorialized to transfer Yao's army to assist the attack.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he encamped at Beiyaitou and requested Yao's army to assist the attack.

sentences.zh: 時烏魯木齊提督成祿猶訴軍糧乏，難赴哈密，詔金順接統其軍。

translations.literal: At this time Urumqi Provincial Military Commander Cheng Lu still complained army grain was lacking and it was hard to go to Hami; Jin Shun was ordered to take command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi commander Cheng Lu still complained of grain shortage and difficulty reaching Hami; Jin Shun was ordered to take his army.

sentences.zh: 十二年，左宗棠至軍，約期並進。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Zuo Zongtang reached the army and set a date for joint advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Zuo Zongtang reached the army and set a date for joint advance.

sentences.zh: 金順發地雷東北角，城潰，乘隙奪據其上，自是老弱伏服者相繼。

translations.literal: Jin Shun detonated mines at the northeast corner; the wall collapsed; seizing the gap they seized the top; from then the old and weak who submitted came in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun detonated mines at the northeast corner; the wall collapsed; seizing the breach they took the top and submissions followed in succession.

sentences.zh: 城拔，復故官。

translations.literal: When the city was taken his former office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell his former office was restored.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊都統景廉駐古城，與金順齟《齒吾》。

translations.literal: Urumqi Commander-in-Chief Jing Lian was stationed at Gucheng and was at odds with Jin Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Urumqi commander Jing Lian was at Gucheng and at odds with Jin Shun.

sentences.zh: 宗棠奏言金順寬和，為群情所附。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang memorialized that Jin Shun was generous and mild and attached to by all hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo memorialized that Jin Shun was generous and beloved by the troops.

sentences.zh: 詔率所部二十營赴之，規烏城，於是遂發。

translations.literal: He was ordered to lead twenty battalions of his troops there and plan for Wucheng; thus they set out.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to lead twenty battalions to plan for Wucheng, he set out.

sentences.zh: 出關數十里，至瀚海，吏士忽不行。

translations.literal: Several tens of li beyond the pass they reached the Gobi; officers and soldiers suddenly would not march.
translations.idiomatic: Several tens of li beyond the pass in the Gobi, officers and soldiers suddenly refused to march.

sentences.zh: 詢之，則曰：「先鋒營駐，有所議。」

translations.literal: On inquiry they said, "The vanguard battalion is halted; there is some dispute."
translations.idiomatic: Asked why, they said, "The vanguard had halted over some dispute."

sentences.zh: 金順知有變，疾馳視，手刃六人以徇，曰：「敢留者，視此！」

translations.literal: Jin Shun knew there was mutiny; he galloped to inspect and personally killed six men as warning, saying, "Whoever dares stay—look at this!"
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun knew mutiny was brewing; he galloped up, personally killed six as warning, and said: "Whoever dares stay—look at this!"

sentences.zh: 軍以次行。

translations.literal: The army marched in order.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched in order.

sentences.zh: 瀚海既過，乃列六屍祝之曰：「雜賦不飽，佐以野蔬，天下無若西軍苦。

translations.literal: After the Gobi was passed he lined up the six corpses and prayed, saying, "Miscellaneous taxes do not fill the belly, supplemented by wild vegetables—nowhere under heaven is an army as hard pressed as the western army.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing the Gobi he lined up the six corpses and said: "Miscellaneous taxes barely fill the belly, supplemented by wild greens—no army under heaven suffers like the western army.

sentences.zh: 此行度戈壁，乏水草，吾非不知。

translations.literal: This march crosses the Gobi lacking water and grass; I am not unaware.
translations.idiomatic: This march crosses waterless Gobi; I know it well.

sentences.zh: 但不忍汝六人，如全軍何？

translations.literal: But I cannot bear you six men—what of the whole army?
translations.idiomatic: But I cannot spare you six—what of the whole army?

sentences.zh: 如國家何？

translations.literal: What of the state?
translations.idiomatic: What of the state?

sentences.zh: 如關內生靈何？」

translations.literal: What of the people within the passes?"
translations.idiomatic: What of the people within the passes?"

sentences.zh: 聞其言者，無不激揚。

translations.literal: Those who heard his words were all stirred.
translations.idiomatic: All who heard were stirred.

sentences.zh: 道授正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On the march he was appointed lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: En route he was appointed lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 明年，至古城，與景廉會師。

translations.literal: The next year he reached Gucheng and joined forces with Jing Lian.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he reached Gucheng and joined Jing Lian.

sentences.zh: 一日演砲，漢、回觀者數千百人。

translations.literal: One day they practiced artillery; several thousand Chinese and Muslim onlookers.
translations.idiomatic: One day they practiced artillery before several thousand Chinese and Muslim onlookers.

sentences.zh: 景軍指敗堵煙筒為的，擊之再，煙筒無恙。

translations.literal: Jing's army aimed at a ruined wall's chimney as target; fired twice; the chimney was unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's men aimed at a ruined wall's chimney; fired twice without effect.

sentences.zh: 所部砲隊總兵鄧增、參將張玉林曰：「是何足擊？

translations.literal: Brigade General Deng Zeng and Colonel Zhang Yulin of his artillery corps said, "What is that worth hitting?
translations.idiomatic: Brigade General Deng Zeng and Colonel Zhang Yulin said: "What is that worth hitting?

sentences.zh: 請卷旗卓之為的。」

translations.literal: Please roll up the banner and set it up as target."
translations.idiomatic: Roll up the banner and set it as target."

sentences.zh: 增先測視，請於金順再測視，既竟，砲響旗飛，若翦霞空際。

translations.literal: Zeng first measured and sighted; he asked Jin Shun to measure again; when done the cannon fired and the banner flew as if cut from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng sighted first, Jin Shun sighted again; the cannon fired and the banner flew as if cut from the sky.

sentences.zh: 已而玉林亦爾。

translations.literal: Soon Yulin did the same.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Yulin did the same.

sentences.zh: 觀者讙謼聲震遠近，回聞之氣奪。

translations.literal: Onlookers cheered till sound shook far and near; the Muslims hearing it lost their spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Onlookers cheered till sound shook far and near; Muslims hearing it lost heart.

sentences.zh: 尋命佐新疆軍務。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to assist in Xinjiang military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to assist in Xinjiang military affairs.

sentences.zh: 光緒改元，代景廉為都統。

translations.literal: At the change to Guangxu he replaced Jing Lian as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the Guangxu change he replaced Jing Lian as commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二年，軍阜康。

translations.literal: In the second year the army was at Fukang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the army was at Fukang.

sentences.zh: 劉錦棠赴軍所商進止，議先攻古牧。

translations.literal: Liu Jintang came to the army to discuss advance; they agreed to attack Gumul first.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jintang came to discuss advance; they agreed to strike Gumul first.

sentences.zh: 乃輕騎襲黃田，通汲道，克之。

translations.literal: Light cavalry then raided Huangtian, opened a water route, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Light cavalry raided Huangtian, secured water, and captured it.

sentences.zh: 連下烏魯木齊、迪化、昌吉、呼圖壁諸城，直偪瑪納斯，斬其偽帥馬興，南北二城以次皆下。

translations.literal: In succession they took Urumqi, Dihua, Changji, Hutubi and other cities, pressed straight on Manas, beheaded the false commander Ma Xing; north and south cities fell in turn.
translations.idiomatic: They took Urumqi, Dihua, Changji, Hutubi and others, pressed on Manas, beheaded false commander Ma Xing, and both north and south cities fell.

sentences.zh: 賞雙眼花翎，予世職，調伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: He was awarded double-peacock feathers, a hereditary rank, and transferred as Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: He received double-peacock feathers, a hereditary rank, and transfer as Ili general.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔接收伊犁，按圖劃界。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to receive Ili and demarcate the border by map.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was ordered to receive Ili and demarcate the border.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，軍標譁變，五月，再變，並譟餉戕官。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, second month, the army standards mutinied; in the fifth month they mutinied again, clamoring for pay and killing officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, second month, the army mutinied; in the fifth month they mutinied again, clamoring for pay and killing officials.

sentences.zh: 伊地本極邊，協餉乖時，軍多疲饉。

translations.literal: Ili was originally an extreme frontier; coordinated pay arrived late and the army often suffered hunger.
translations.idiomatic: Ili was an extreme frontier; pay arrived late and the army often went hungry.

sentences.zh: 金順馭眾寬，將領營官相率蒙蔽，而總督譚鍾麟劾其上下縱恣，民怨沸騰，為陳籌餉易人之策。

translations.literal: Jin Shun was lenient with the masses; generals and camp officers together deceived him; Governor Tan Zhonglin impeached him for indulgence above and below until popular resentment boiled, and proposed replacing the pay officer.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun was lenient; officers deceived him; Governor Tan Zhonglin impeached his indulgence until resentment boiled and proposed replacing the pay officer.

sentences.zh: 於是上召來京，以錫綸代之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the throne summoned him to the capital and Xi Lun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: The throne summoned him to the capital and Xi Lun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 道肅州，病卒。

translations.literal: Passing Suzhou he fell ill and died.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Suzhou he fell ill and died.

sentences.zh: 身後不名一錢，幾無以為斂。

translations.literal: After death he did not leave a single cash; burial was nearly impossible.
translations.idiomatic: He left not a single cash after death; burial was nearly impossible.

sentences.zh: 寮寀醵金，喪始歸。

translations.literal: Colleagues pooled money before the coffin could return.
translations.idiomatic: Colleagues pooled money before the coffin could return.

sentences.zh: 部伍縞素，步行五千里至京者，達二百人云。

translations.literal: The ranks wore white hemp; two hundred walked five thousand li to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred men in white hemp walked five thousand li to the capital.

sentences.zh: 事聞，贈太子太保，諡忠介，予建祠。

translations.literal: When word arrived he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, titled Zhongjie, and granted a memorial shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Word arrived; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, titled Zhongjie, and granted a memorial shrine.

sentences.zh: 妻託莫洛氏，婚甫踰月，囑事繼母，撫諸弟，遂出。

translations.literal: His wife of the Tuomoluo clan: marriage had barely passed a month when he ordered her to serve his stepmother and care for his younger brothers, then departed.
translations.idiomatic: His wife of the Tuomoluo clan: marriage had barely passed a month when he ordered her to serve his stepmother and care for his brothers, then departed.

sentences.zh: 轉戰二十餘年，至新疆，乃遣使往迓。

translations.literal: Fighting more than twenty years, reaching Xinjiang, he then sent an envoy to fetch her.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty years of fighting, reaching Xinjiang, he sent to fetch her.

sentences.zh: 謂使者曰：「太夫人老矣，寧能涉萬里？

translations.literal: He told the envoy, "My mother is old; how could she cross ten thousand li?
translations.idiomatic: He told the envoy: "My mother is old; how could she cross ten thousand li?

sentences.zh: 吾義不得獨行。

translations.literal: By righteousness I cannot go alone.
translations.idiomatic: By duty I cannot go alone.

sentences.zh: 且彼處有姬侍，宗祧不墜，吾又何求？」

translations.literal: Besides, there are concubines there; the ancestral line will not fall—what more do I seek?"
translations.idiomatic: Besides, there are concubines there; the line will not fall—what more do I need?"

sentences.zh: 竟不往。

translations.literal: He never went.
translations.idiomatic: He never went.

sentences.zh: 時論賢之。

translations.literal: Contemporaries praised his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Contemporaries praised his virtue.

sentences.zh: 增，字錦亭，籍廣東新會。

translations.literal: Zeng, courtesy name Jinting, registered domicile Xinhui, Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Zeng, styled Jinting, was registered at Xinhui in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 年十七從軍，積勳至游擊。

translations.literal: At seventeen he joined the army; for accumulated merit he reached battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: At seventeen he joined the army and rose through merit to battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 西征之役，領開花砲隊，平金積，取河州，並以善用砲知名。

translations.literal: In the western campaign he led an explosive artillery corps, pacified Jinjibao, took Hezhou, and was famed for skilled artillery.
translations.idiomatic: In the western campaign he led explosive artillery, pacified Jinjibao and took Hezhou, and was famed for artillery skill.

sentences.zh: 方是時，錦棠治兵西寧，寇堅壁自守，而牧馬湟水北岸。

translations.literal: At this time Jintang was drilling troops at Xining; the bandits held firm in their walls while grazing horses on the north bank of the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang was drilling at Xining; rebels held their walls while grazing horses on the Huang River's north bank.

sentences.zh: 增隔水轟擊，寇駭愕逾山遁。

translations.literal: Zeng bombarded across the water; the bandits fled in alarm over the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng bombarded across the water; rebels fled in alarm over the mountains.

sentences.zh: 增馳之，先以輕騎當寇，乍戰佯北。

translations.literal: Zeng galloped after them, first sent light cavalry to meet the bandits and in sudden battle feigned retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng galloped after them, sent light cavalry to meet them, and in sudden battle feigned retreat.

sentences.zh: 寇易之，悉眾下山，我​​師以巨砲環擊，大潰。

translations.literal: The bandits underestimated them; all came down the mountain; our army surrounded them with heavy guns and they collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels underestimated them and came down the mountain; heavy guns surrounded them and they collapsed.

sentences.zh: 俄援寇至，壁平戎驛。

translations.literal: Before long relief bandits arrived and walled up at Pingyi Post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon relief rebels arrived and fortified Pingyi Post.

sentences.zh: 錦棠不與戰，而使增據山上俯擊。

translations.literal: Jintang would not fight them but had Zeng hold the mountain above and strike downward.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang would not fight directly but had Zeng hold the heights and strike down.

sentences.zh: 寇懾砲威，退湟北，增复隔河擊之，皆走。

translations.literal: The bandits feared artillery power, retreated north of the Huang, and Zeng again struck across the river; all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels feared the guns, retreated north of the Huang, and Zeng struck across the river again; all fled.

sentences.zh: 錦棠攻高寨急，舁大砲列北山上，使增測準寇壘，發砲子六十餘，牆壁皆裂，賜號伊博德恩巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Jintang urgently attacked Gaozhai; heavy guns were raised on the north hill; Zeng was made to sight the rebel fort; more than sixty shells were fired and walls all cracked; he was granted the title Yibode'en Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: Jintang urgently attacked Gaozhai; heavy guns on the north hill under Zeng's sighting fired more than sixty shells and cracked the walls; he received the title Yibode'en Baturn.

sentences.zh: 規肅州，城高厚逾常制，增築砲台臨城關，轟潰十餘丈。

translations.literal: Planning for Suzhou, the walls were higher and thicker than usual; Zeng built batteries overlooking the city gate and bombardment breached more than ten zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Planning Suzhou, whose walls exceeded usual height and thickness, Zeng built batteries overlooking the gate and breached more than ten zhang.

sentences.zh: 繼复築砲台街口，裹創力戰，卒擊退之，晉總兵。

translations.literal: He again built a battery at Street Mouth, fought wounded, and at last beat them back; he was promoted brigade general.
translations.idiomatic: He built another battery at Street Mouth, fought wounded, beat them back, and was promoted brigade general.

sentences.zh: 從金順出關，以戰功擢提督。

translations.literal: Following Jin Shun beyond the pass, for battle merit he was promoted provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Following Jin Shun beyond the pass he was promoted provincial military commander for battle merit.

sentences.zh: 金順舉將才，稱增精究砲術。

translations.literal: Jin Shun cited general talent and praised Zeng for mastering artillery science.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun praised Zeng for mastering artillery science.

sentences.zh: 除伊犁鎮，調西寧。

translations.literal: Appointed Ili garrison commander, transferred to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Ili garrison commander, he was transferred to Xining.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十一年，解循化圍，回渡河趨巴燕戎格，增追至思觀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Guangxu he relieved the Xunhua siege; Muslims crossed the river toward Bayan Rongge; Zeng pursued to Siguan.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21 he relieved the Xunhua siege; Muslims crossed toward Bayan Rongge and Zeng pursued to Siguan.

sentences.zh: 會札什巴陷，分三路擊之，城拔。

translations.literal: Just as Zhaxiba fell he struck on three routes and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: As Zhaxiba fell he struck on three routes and took the city.

sentences.zh: 六月，西寧回韓文秀等犯增營，增分軍迎擊，遇伏將卻，增手刃先退者以徇，眾皆躍馬陷陣，寇潰。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Xining Muslims Han Wenxiu and others attacked Zeng's camp; Zeng divided forces to meet them, met ambush and was about to retreat; Zeng personally killed the first to fall back as warning; all leaped their horses into the line; the bandits collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Han Wenxiu and others attacked Zeng's camp; ambushed, he personally killed the first to retreat; all charged; rebels collapsed.

sentences.zh: 時西寧南北西川、大通、碾伯、丹噶爾皆叛，增聞警，馳歸守郡城。

translations.literal: At this time south, north, west Sichuan, Datong, Nianbo, and Dangar in Xining all rebelled; hearing alarm Zeng galloped back to defend the prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: South, north, and west Sichuan, Datong, Nianbo, and Dangar all rebelled; hearing alarm Zeng galloped back to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 八月，哆吧寇來襲城，薄小橋。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Duoba bandits came to assault the city and pressed the small bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Duoba bandits assaulted the city and pressed the small bridge.

sentences.zh: 增將出拒，或勸沮之，增曰：「寇氛甚惡，不力遏之，是示弱也。

translations.literal: Zeng was about to go out to resist; some urged him to stop; Zeng said, "The bandit threat is very fierce; if we do not forcefully check them, that shows weakness.
translations.idiomatic: About to go out, some urged caution; Zeng said: "The threat is fierce; failing to check it shows weakness.

sentences.zh: 且主帥不出，將士孰肯用命？」

translations.literal: Besides, if the commander does not go out, which officer will willingly give his life?"
translations.idiomatic: If the commander stays in, who will fight to the death?"

sentences.zh: 遂往，短兵接，人百其氣，大敗之。

translations.literal: He then went; at close quarters morale multiplied a hundredfold and they inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He went out; at close quarters morale multiplied and they routed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 自此寇望見鄧軍旗幟，輒不戰而遁。

translations.literal: From then on whenever bandits saw Deng's army banners they fled without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter bandits fled at sight of Deng's banners without fighting.

sentences.zh: 明年，克川北、營城，關內外平，授固原提督。

translations.literal: The next year he took Chuanbei and Yingcheng; within and beyond the passes were pacified; he was appointed Guyuan provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he took Chuanbei and Yingcheng; the region was pacified and he was appointed Guyuan provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 既至，會甘軍搜治海城叛回。

translations.literal: On arrival he met Gansu troops suppressing Haicheng rebel Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he joined Gansu troops suppressing Haicheng rebel Muslims.

sentences.zh: 閱三年，海城回田百連复叛，遣將討平之。

translations.literal: After three years Haicheng Muslim Tian Bailian rebelled again; he sent generals to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later Tian Bailian rebelled again; he sent generals to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 拳亂作，車駕西狩，召赴行在。

translations.literal: When the Boxer affair arose the imperial carriage fled west; he was summoned to the temporary court.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer affair arose and the court fled west he was summoned to the temporary capital.

sentences.zh: 回鑾，節度隨扈諸軍，晉頭品服。

translations.literal: On the return he directed escort forces and was promoted to first-rank dress.
translations.idiomatic: On the return he directed escort forces and rose to first rank.

sentences.zh: 旋回任。

translations.literal: Soon he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，卒於官，詔附祀宗棠祠。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he died in office; he was ordered attached worship at Zuo Zongtang's shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he died in office and was ordered attached worship at Zuo Zongtang's shrine.

sentences.zh: 其時隨金順徵回著績者，又有托雲布、果權、劉宏發、曹正興。

translations.literal: At that time those who followed Jin Shun in the Muslim campaign and won distinction also included Tuo Yunbu, Guo Quan, Liu Hongfa, and Cao Zhengxing.
translations.idiomatic: Others who followed Jin Shun against the Muslims with distinction included Tuo Yunbu, Guo Quan, Liu Hongfa, and Cao Zhengxing.

sentences.zh: 托雲布，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Tuo Yunbu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tuo Yunbu, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初，從軍剿發、捻，賜號綽勒郭蘭闊巴圖魯。

translations.literal: At first he followed the army suppressing the Taiping and Nian and was granted the title Chuoleguolan Kuo Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: He first campaigned against Taiping and Nian rebels and received the title Chuoleguolan Kuo Baturn.

sentences.zh: 攻寧夏，釋平羅圍，襲擊黃河兩岸，數有功，累遷協領，坐事免。

translations.literal: Attacking Ningxia he lifted the Pingluo siege, raided both banks of the Yellow River, won repeatedly, was promoted assistant commandant, and was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Ningxia he lifted the Pingluo siege, raided both banks of the Yellow River, rose to assistant commandant, and was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 金順請留軍自贖，截擊竄寇於榆林，复官。

translations.literal: Jin Shun asked to keep him with the army to redeem himself; he intercepted fleeing bandits at Yulin and was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun kept him with the army to redeem himself; he intercepted fleeing bandits at Yulin and was restored.

sentences.zh: 進拔蘇家燒房、納中閘，晉副都統。

translations.literal: Advancing he took Sujia Shaofang and Nazhong Gate and was promoted deputy lieutenant general.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to take Sujia Shaofang and Nazhong Gate and was promoted deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 時寇據金積，其旁堡砦並險固。

translations.literal: At this time bandits held Jinjibao; neighboring forts and stockades were all perilously strong.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Jinjibao; neighboring forts were all perilously strong.

sentences.zh: 托雲布充前鋒，大小數十戰，寇稍卻，克王家甿，賜頭品服；

translations.literal: Tuo Yunbu served as vanguard; in several tens of battles large and small the bandits slightly withdrew; Wang Jiamang was taken; he was granted first rank;
translations.idiomatic: As vanguard in dozens of battles rebels withdrew; Wang Jiamang fell; he received first rank;

sentences.zh: 平通昌各寨，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: pacifying Tongchang stockades he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: pacifying Tongchang stockades he received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 自是從出關，迭克名城，即於軍前授青州副都統。

translations.literal: From then he followed beyond the pass, captured famous cities in succession, and was appointed at the front deputy lieutenant general of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he followed beyond the pass, captured famous cities, and was appointed Qingzhou deputy lieutenant general at the front.

sentences.zh: 瑪納斯之役，血戰六十餘日，天山以北告寧，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the Manas campaign he fought bloody battles for more than sixty days; north of Tianshan was declared calm; he was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank.
translations.idiomatic: At Manas he fought bloody battles for sixty days; north of Tianshan was calm; he received a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captain rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，創發乞歸，賞食全俸。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Guangxu he memorialized illness to retire and was granted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 11 he retired citing illness with full salary granted.

sentences.zh: 十八年，卒，予優恤。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he died; generous mourning rites were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he died with generous mourning rites.

sentences.zh: 果權，莫得里氏，滿洲正藍旗人，吉林駐防。

translations.literal: Guo Quan, of the Modeli clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner, garrisoned at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Quan, of the Modeli clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner garrisoned at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 驍騎校，從副都統福珠裡出師伊犁。

translations.literal: Daring cavalry commandant; he followed Deputy Lieutenant General Fuzhuli on campaign to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: A daring cavalry commandant, he followed Deputy Lieutenant General Fuzhuli to Ili.

sentences.zh: 以戰功，累遷協領。

translations.literal: For battle merit he was promoted in succession to assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: For battle merit he rose to assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 瑪納斯既复，金順薦署伊犁錫伯營領隊大臣，頓車排子屯田。

translations.literal: After Manas was recovered Jin Shun recommended him acting Ili Xibo garrison commander, encamped at Chepaizi for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: After Manas fell Jin Shun recommended him acting Ili Xibo garrison commander at Chepaizi garrison farms.

sentences.zh: 詔念前勞，晉副都統，賜號志勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The decree remembered former merit; he was promoted deputy lieutenant general and granted the title Zhiyong Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: Remembering former merit, he was promoted deputy lieutenant general and granted the title Zhiyong Baturn.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，調充東三省練兵行營翼長，校閱吉林邊練各軍。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu he was transferred wing commander of the Northeast Three Provinces training camp and inspected border training forces of Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 17 he became wing commander of Northeast training camps and inspected Jilin border forces.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，授呼蘭副都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed deputy lieutenant general of Hulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed Hulan deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: He died; mourning followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: He died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 宏發，黃陂人。

translations.literal: Hongfa was a native of Huangpi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hongfa came from Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 正興，鄖西人。

translations.literal: Zhengxing was a native of Yunxi.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhengxing came from Yunxi.

sentences.zh: 自同治初久從金順軍，复肅州，進新疆，屢有功，後皆官至提督。

translations.literal: From early Tongzhi they long followed Jin Shun's army, recovered Suzhou, advanced into Xinjiang, repeatedly won merit; later both reached provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: From early Tongzhi they long followed Jin Shun, recovered Suzhou, advanced into Xinjiang, and later both reached provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 而宏發軍過玉門、安西，官民尤翕，頌讚不置雲。

translations.literal: When Hongfa's army passed Yumen and Anxi, officials and people were especially harmonious and praise was unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: When Hongfa's army passed Yumen and Anxi, officials and people were especially harmonious and praise was unceasing.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善，字春岩，那拉搭氏，世居黑龍江齊齊哈爾，隸滿洲鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan, courtesy name Chunyan, of the Nara clan, long resident at Qiqihar on the Amur, registered in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan, styled Chunyan, of the Nara clan from Qiqihar on the Amur, was registered in the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 家貧，事親孝。

translations.literal: The family was poor; he served his parents filially.
translations.idiomatic: Born poor, he served his parents filially.

sentences.zh: 初以驍騎校遷參領，從征直、魯、晉、豫，所向有功。

translations.literal: At first as daring cavalry commandant he was transferred battalion commander; he followed campaigns in Zhi, Lu, Jin, and Yu and won merit wherever he went.
translations.idiomatic: First a daring cavalry commandant then battalion commander, he campaigned in Zhili, Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan with merit wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 援安徽，迭克城隘，賜號西林巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Aiding Anhui he captured cities and passes in succession and was granted the title Xilin Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: Aiding Anhui he captured cities and passes and received the title Xilin Baturn.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，從多隆阿入陝，道鄧州，遇粵寇陳得才，敗之紫荊關，擢西安右翼副都統。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Duolong'a into Shaanxi; on the road at Dengzhou he met Guangdong bandit Chen Deicai and defeated him at Zijing Pass; he was promoted deputy lieutenant general of the Xi'an Right Wing.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 he followed Duolong'a into Shaanxi; at Dengzhou he defeated Guangdong bandit Chen Deicai at Zijing Pass and was promoted Xi'an Right Wing deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 時回氛熾，率步旅扼洛水北岸，半修營，半出擊寇，寇始奔。

translations.literal: At this time Muslim unrest blazed; he led infantry to hold the north bank of the Luo River, half building camps and half sallying to strike bandits; the bandits at last fled.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim unrest blazed; he held the Luo's north bank, half building camps and half sallying until rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 亡何，捻酋姜泰林犯武關，夜襲多軍。

translations.literal: Before long Nian chieftain Jiang Tailin invaded Wuguan and by night raided Duo's army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Nian chieftain Jiang Tailin invaded Wuguan and raided Duo's army by night.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善設伏敗之，追群寇入鄂境，悉驅出西河口。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan set an ambush and defeated them, pursued the mass of bandits into Hubei territory, and drove them all out at Xihekou.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan ambushed and defeated them, pursued into Hubei, and drove them out at Xihekou.

sentences.zh: 二年，再入陝，攻高陵，先登，裡創力戰，下之，賞黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the second year he again entered Shaanxi, attacked Gaoling, was first to ascend, fought wounded, and took it; he was awarded a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he re-entered Shaanxi, was first up Gaoling's walls, fought wounded, took it, and received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 寇渡涇據南岸，穆圖善泅水而濟，寇大潰。

translations.literal: Bandits crossed the Jing and held the south bank; Mu Tushan swam the river and crossed; the bandits collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held the Jing's south bank; Mu Tushan swam across and routed them.

sentences.zh: 三年，多隆阿圍盩厔，中砲，病篤，疏薦穆圖善賢，遂命署欽差大臣。

translations.literal: In the third year Duolong'a besieged Zhouzhi, was hit by cannon, grew gravely ill, memorialized recommending Mu Tushan's worth, and he was ordered acting Imperial Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Duolong'a besieged Zhouzhi, was mortally wounded by cannon, recommended Mu Tushan, and he was named acting Imperial Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 其夏，擢荊州將軍，與劉蓉會辦陝事。

translations.literal: That summer he was promoted Jingzhou general and with Liu Rong jointly handled Shaanxi affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That summer he was promoted Jingzhou general and with Liu Rong jointly handled Shaanxi affairs.

sentences.zh: 粵寇據樓觀、黑水、西駝峪，蓉遣蕭慶高趨鄠，穆圖善率師助擊，戰店子頭，敗績。

translations.literal: Guangdong bandits held Louguan, Heishui, and Xituoyu; Rong sent Xiao Qinggao toward Hu; Mu Tushan led troops to assist the attack; at battle at Dianzitou they suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong bandits held Louguan, Heishui, and Xituoyu; Rong sent Xiao Qinggao toward Hu; Mu Tushan assisted and was defeated at Dianzitou.

sentences.zh: 七月，擊破大峪西堡，進攻樓觀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he broke Daxu West Fort and advanced to attack Louguan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he broke Daxu West Fort and advanced on Louguan.

sentences.zh: 先是，得才入鄂，穆圖善遣二十八營赴援，無統帥。

translations.literal: Earlier Deicai had entered Hubei; Mu Tushan sent twenty-eight battalions to aid without a commander.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Deicai had entered Hubei; Mu Tushan sent twenty-eight battalions without a commander.

sentences.zh: 至是蓉奏請穆圖善往湖北，詔勿許，令移師赴甘。

translations.literal: At this Rong memorialized asking Mu Tushan to go to Hubei; the decree did not permit it and ordered him to move troops to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Rong asked Mu Tushan to go to Hubei; the decree refused and ordered him to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 既至，與將軍都興阿議定先規寧夏。

translations.literal: On arrival he with General Duxing'a planned first to target Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he and General Duxing'a planned first to target Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 十一月，檄杜嘎爾、額爾慶額等攻破清水堡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he ordered Du Gaer, E Erqing'e, and others to break Qingshui Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he ordered Du Gaer, E Erqing'e, and others to break Qingshui Fort.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，诇知群寇元日椎牛置酒，必不誡。

translations.literal: A year later he learned that on New Year's Day the mass of bandits would slaughter cattle and feast and would certainly not be on guard.
translations.idiomatic: A year later he learned rebels would feast on New Year's Day and would not be on guard.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善奪城南砲台，連毀其寨。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan seized the south city batteries and in succession destroyed their stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan seized south city batteries and destroyed their stockades in succession.

sentences.zh: 已，复慮寇乘春漲決渠下灌，分兵扼城東南。

translations.literal: Soon he again feared bandits would use spring flood to break canals and flood downward; he divided troops to hold southeast of the city.
translations.idiomatic: He feared rebels would break canals in spring flood; he divided troops to hold the southeast.

sentences.zh: 尋調寧夏將軍，主甘肅軍事。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred Ningxia general and commanded Gansu military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred Ningxia general and commanded Gansu military affairs.

sentences.zh: 嗣以寧夏諸軍久不得要領，責之。

translations.literal: Later because Ningxia's armies long failed to grasp essentials he was rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because Ningxia's armies long failed to grasp essentials, he was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 五年，收靈州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he recovered Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he recovered Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 初，回寇馬兆元攻陷州城，馬朝清計誅之，禁靈回無滋事。

translations.literal: At first Muslim bandit Ma Zhaoyuan attacked and took the prefectural city; Ma Chaoqing plotted to kill him and forbade Ling Muslims from causing trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Muslim bandit Ma Zhaoyuan had taken Lingzhou; Ma Chaoqing killed him and forbade Ling Muslims from causing trouble.

sentences.zh: 逮寧夏失，道且梗塞。

translations.literal: When Ningxia fell the route was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningxia fell the route was blocked.

sentences.zh: 朝清者化龍也。

translations.literal: Chaoqing was Hualong.
translations.idiomatic: Chaoqing was Hualong.

sentences.zh: 至是，親詣穆圖善哀詞乞款。

translations.literal: At this he personally went to Mu Tushan with piteous words begging terms.
translations.idiomatic: He personally went to Mu Tushan with piteous pleas for terms.

sentences.zh: 會州紳亦請置官，乃使丰紳等往招撫，州事定。

translations.literal: Just then prefectural gentry also asked to place officials; Feng Shen and others were sent to recruit and pacify; prefectural affairs were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural gentry also asked for officials; Feng Shen and others were sent to pacify and affairs were settled.

sentences.zh: 聞華亭回竄慶陽，復遣軍擊走之，城圍解。

translations.literal: Hearing Huating Muslims had fled to Qingyang he again sent troops to drive them off and the city siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Huating Muslims had fled to Qingyang he sent troops to drive them off and lifted the siege.

sentences.zh: 明年，署陝甘總督，值歲大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: The next year he served acting governor of Shaan-Gan; the year suffered great famine and people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: The next year as acting Shaan-Gan governor the province suffered great famine and people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 乃馳書阿拉善王，令運蒙糧至河北，與軍民交易，食乃濟。

translations.literal: He then sent letters to the Alashan prince ordering transport of Mongol grain to north of the river for trade with army and people; food was thus supplied.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the Alashan prince to transport Mongol grain north of the river for trade with army and people; food was supplied.

sentences.zh: 是時米拉溝既下，河、洮、狄道、西寧回皆反正，而南八營李得昌各部，乞擇地安插。

translations.literal: At this time Milagou had fallen; Muslims of He, Tao, Didao, and Xining all returned to allegiance; while the southern eight camps under Li Dechang begged to choose lands for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: Milagou had fallen; He, Tao, Didao, and Xining Muslims returned to allegiance; Li Dechang's southern eight camps begged lands for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 上慮回情叵測，敕穆圖善嚴備之。

translations.literal: The throne feared Muslim sentiment was unpredictable and ordered Mu Tushan to guard strictly.
translations.idiomatic: The throne feared Muslim sentiment was unpredictable and ordered strict guard.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善令降回繳械，遣範銘赴洮，張瑞珍赴蕭何城，王得勝赴靜寧辦撫事，自是頗惑撫議。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan ordered surrendered Muslims to surrender arms; he sent Fan Ming to Tao, Zhang Ruizhen to Xiaohe City, and Wang Desheng to Jingning to handle pacification; thus he was quite swayed by pacification policy.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan ordered surrendered Muslims to turn in arms and sent Fan Ming, Zhang Ruizhen, and Wang Desheng to handle pacification; he was swayed by pacification policy.

sentences.zh: 已，復使曹熙等赴河州，回羈之，遣黨潛襲省城，聲款附。

translations.literal: Soon he again sent Cao Xi and others to Hezhou; the Muslims detained them; parties secretly raided the provincial capital feigning submission.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Cao Xi to Hezhou; Muslims detained them while parties secretly raided the capital feigning submission.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善率輕騎往，中伏奔還，遂圍城五日，楚軍將彭楚漢等破之。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan led light cavalry there, was ambushed and fled back; the city was besieged five days; Hunan Army General Peng Chuhan and others broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan led light cavalry, was ambushed and fled; the city was besieged five days until Peng Chuhan broke the siege.

sentences.zh: 而東鄉回嵎負如故，穆圖善親督諸軍敗之。

translations.literal: But Dongxiang Muslims remained entrenched as before; Mu Tushan personally directed the armies and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxiang Muslims remained entrenched; Mu Tushan personally directed armies and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，攻州城，弗克，還蘭州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he attacked the prefectural city without success and returned to Lanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he attacked the prefectural city without success and returned to Lanzhou.

sentences.zh: 會傅先宗敗回禮縣，彭忠國敗回安定，穆圖善乃令進規渭源，而自從金縣進。

translations.literal: Just then Fu Xianzong was defeated by Muslims at Li County and Peng Zhongguo was defeated at Anding; Mu Tushan then ordered advance on Weiyuan while he himself advanced from Jin County.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Xianzong was defeated at Li County and Peng Zhongguo at Anding; Mu Tushan ordered advance on Weiyuan while he advanced from Jin County.

sentences.zh: 七年正月，克之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year it was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year Weiyuan was taken.

sentences.zh: 乃使諸將會攻狄道，南北兩山相崟，中有平川，寨卡林立，先宗等一鼓破之，毀其寺，軍威大振。

translations.literal: He then had the generals jointly attack Didao; north and south hills faced each other steeply with a flat valley between; stockades and passes stood thickly; Xianzong and others broke them in one rush, destroyed their temple, and army prestige greatly revived.
translations.idiomatic: Generals jointly attacked Didao; steep hills flanked a flat valley thick with stockades; Xianzong broke them in one rush, destroyed their temple, and army prestige revived.

sentences.zh: 於是穆圖善赴前敵，北莊牟佛提率男婦三千人乞降，受之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mu Tushan went to the front; Beizhuang Moufoti led three thousand men, women, and children begging surrender and was accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan went forward; Beizhuang Moufoti led three thousand men, women, and children to surrender and was accepted.

sentences.zh: 師旋，复叛。

translations.literal: When the army turned back they rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: When the army turned back they rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善再渡河，直搗黑山頭、太子寺。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan again crossed the river and struck straight at Heishantou and Taizi Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan crossed the river again and struck Heishantou and Taizi Temple.

sentences.zh: 寇斷我糧運，戰數失利，不獲已，退保狄道。

translations.literal: Bandits cut our grain transport; several battles were lost; with no choice he fell back to defend Didao.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels cut grain transport; after several defeats he fell back to Didao.

sentences.zh: 明年，狄城糧盡，又退至秦州，寇乘之，師潰。

translations.literal: The next year Didao's grain was exhausted and he again fell back to Qinzhou; bandits pressed and the army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Didao's grain ran out and he fell back to Qinzhou; rebels pressed and the army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 朝旨令穆圖善甘軍受左宗棠節度。

translations.literal: Imperial orders placed Gansu troops under Zuo Zongtang's command.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial orders placed Gansu troops under Zuo Zongtang's command.

sentences.zh: 初，穆圖善狃撫議，群回叛服靡恆，而所部百數十營皆徵糧民間。

translations.literal: At first Mu Tushan clung to pacification policy; Muslim groups rebelled and submitted without constancy; his more than a hundred battalions all levied grain from the people.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan clung to pacification; Muslims rebelled and submitted without constancy; his hundred-plus battalions all levied grain from the people.

sentences.zh: 清水守將敖天印以橫暴激民變，逐防軍，殺縣役。

translations.literal: Qingshui garrison commander Ao Tianyin provoked popular revolt by tyranny, drove out garrison troops, and killed county runners.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshui garrison commander Ao Tianyin provoked revolt by tyranny, drove out garrison troops, and killed county runners.

sentences.zh: 提督黃金山率所部戰狄道康家岩，敗潰，北入皋蘭，四出淫掠。

translations.literal: Brigade General Huang Jinshan led his unit to fight at Didao Kangjiayan, was defeated and routed, entered north Gaolan, and raided in all directions.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade General Huang Jinshan fought at Didao Kangjiayan, was routed, entered Gaolan, and raided in all directions.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善乃遣潰勇屯寧夏，而訾報敖軍於朝，敖軍亦力詆之。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan then sent routed troops to garrison Ningxia while denouncing Ao's army at court; Ao's army also fiercely denounced him.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan garrisoned routed troops at Ningxia while denouncing Ao at court; Ao's men denounced him in turn.

sentences.zh: 於是宗棠調度諸軍，先秦州固餉源，遂赴涇州受總督印。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zuo Zongtang coordinated the armies, first secured Qinzhou's grain source, then went to Jingzhou to receive the governor's seal.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo coordinated armies, secured Qinzhou's grain source, then went to Jingzhou for the governor's seal.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善既卸事，猶日曆四鄉，勸民修堡寨，置軍械，蘭人甚德之。

translations.literal: After Mu Tushan relinquished affairs he still daily toured the four townships urging people to repair fort stockades and set out arms; Lanzhou people greatly esteemed him.
translations.idiomatic: After relinquishing command he still toured townships urging fort repairs and arms; Lanzhou people esteemed him.

sentences.zh: 詔仍駐蘭州，統西路軍。

translations.literal: He was ordered still to be stationed at Lanzhou commanding the western route army.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to remain at Lanzhou commanding the western route army.

sentences.zh: 化龍黨崔三構河、狄回出擾，輒敗去。

translations.literal: Hualong's follower Cui San stirred He and Di Muslims to raid outward; they were repeatedly defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Hualong's follower Cui San stirred He and Di Muslims to raid; they were repeatedly defeated.

sentences.zh: 十年，河州賊襲陷皋蘭西古城，再敗之，長驅北山兔窩，寇大潰。

translations.literal: In the tenth year Hezhou bandits raided and took Xigu Old City west of Gaolan; he defeated them again and drove north to Tuwowa; the bandits collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year Hezhou bandits took Xigu Old City west of Gaolan; he defeated them again at Tuwowa and routed them.

sentences.zh: 其冬，會左軍渡河，連克要塞，寇退扼大東鄉，師聚而殲之。

translations.literal: That winter joining Zuo's army crossing the river they captured strongpoints in succession; bandits retreated to hold Dadongxiang and the army gathered and wiped them out.
translations.idiomatic: That winter joining Zuo's river crossing they took strongpoints; rebels held Dadongxiang and were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 論功，予世職。

translations.literal: For merit he was granted a hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he received a hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，召署正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was summoned acting lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 he was summoned acting lieutenant general of the Plain White Banner Chinese Army.

sentences.zh: 會吉林馬賊竄巴彥蘇蘇，命權將軍，捕治之，漸散其黨與。

translations.literal: Just then Jilin horse bandits fled to Bayansusu; he was ordered acting general, captured and punished them, and gradually dispersed their associates.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin horse bandits fled to Bayansusu; as acting general he captured them and dispersed their associates.

sentences.zh: 明年，道員舒之翰獲譴，罪及舉主，褫職。

translations.literal: The next year Circuit Intendant Shu Zhihan was punished; guilt extended to the recommender and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Circuit Intendant Shu Zhihan was punished; his recommender was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 又明年，起授青州副都統，擢察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: The year after next he was raised appointing Qingzhou deputy lieutenant general and promoted Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was raised to Qingzhou deputy lieutenant general and promoted Chahar commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 五年，出為福州將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he went out as Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 法人爭地越南，分兵艦窺閩疆，詔參宗棠軍事。

translations.literal: The French disputed land in Vietnam and divided warships to spy on Fujian borders; he was ordered to assist Zuo Zongtang in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the French disputed Vietnam and sent warships toward Fujian he was ordered to assist Zuo Zongtang.

sentences.zh: 出駐長門，誓師設伏，擊沉法艦一艘。

translations.literal: He went out to garrison Changmen, swore the army, set ambushes, and sank one French warship.
translations.idiomatic: He garrisoned Changmen, swore the army, set ambushes, and sank a French warship.

sentences.zh: 既而防軍潰，法人登岸搦戰，伏起，轉敗為功。

translations.literal: Soon the garrison collapsed; the French landed and challenged battle; ambush rose and defeat was turned to victory.
translations.idiomatic: When garrison collapsed the French landed; ambush rose and defeat became victory.

sentences.zh: 以故閩事壞，獨免議。

translations.literal: Therefore Fujian affairs went badly but he alone escaped censure.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian affairs went badly but he alone escaped censure.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔授欽差大臣，會辦東三省練兵事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered Imperial Commissioner to jointly manage Northeast Three Provinces training affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was named Imperial Commissioner for Northeast training affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年，以積勞卒於軍，諡果勇。

translations.literal: The next year he died in camp from accumulated labor; he was posthumously titled Guoyong.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he died in camp from overwork and was posthumously titled Guoyong.

sentences.zh: 予黑龍江、安徽、甘肅建祠，蘭民且樹碑誌德焉。

translations.literal: Memorial shrines were granted in Heilongjiang, Anhui, and Gansu; Lanzhou people also erected a stele recording his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Memorial shrines were granted in Heilongjiang, Anhui, and Gansu; Lanzhou people erected a stele to his virtue.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾，哈勒斌氏，滿洲正藍旗人，黑龍江駐防。

translations.literal: Du Gaer, of the Halebin clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner, garrisoned at Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Du Gaer, of the Halebin clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner garrisoned at Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 初從都興阿徵粵寇，積勳至佐領，賜號莽賚巴圖魯。

translations.literal: At first he followed Duxing'a against Guangdong bandits; for accumulated merit he reached company commander and was granted the title Mangzai Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: He first followed Duxing'a against Guangdong bandits, rose to company commander, and received the title Mangzai Baturn.

sentences.zh: 嗣以京口副都統從討甘回，規寧、靈，頗能以少擊眾。

translations.literal: Later as deputy lieutenant general of Jingkou he followed the campaign against Gansu Muslims, planning for Ning and Ling, and could often defeat many with few.
translations.idiomatic: Later as Jingkou deputy lieutenant general he campaigned against Gansu Muslims at Ning and Ling and often defeated many with few.

sentences.zh: 寇竄寶豐，克張家村、紅柳堡，深入沙磧，背水成軍，旬日間城复。

translations.literal: Bandits fled to Baofeng; he took Zhangjia Village and Hongliubao, penetrated deep into sand desert, formed army with back to water, and within ten days the city was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels fled to Baofeng; he took Zhangjia Village and Hongliubao, fought with back to water in the desert, and recovered the city within ten days.

sentences.zh: 攻寧郡，斬虜多，即於軍前調官寧夏。

translations.literal: Attacking Ning Prefecture he beheaded many captives and was transferred at the front to Ningxia command.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Ning Prefecture he killed many and was transferred at the front to Ningxia command.

sentences.zh: 寧城回增建寨棚，首城南訖納家閘。

translations.literal: Ning city Muslims added stockades and sheds from the city head south to Najia Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Ning Muslims added stockades from the city south to Najia Gate.

sentences.zh: 與金順誘城東寇出，數敗之，乘勝破護城堤清水堡。

translations.literal: With Jin Shun he lured east-city bandits out, defeated them repeatedly, and pressing the victory broke the protective dike Qingshui Fort.
translations.idiomatic: With Jin Shun he lured east-city rebels out, defeated them repeatedly, and broke Qingshui Fort on the protective dike.

sentences.zh: 尋隨都興阿赴奉天，調補正藍旗蒙古副都統，歷察哈爾，坐事免。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Duxing'a to Fengtian, was transferred Mongol deputy lieutenant general of the Plain Blue Banner, served in Chahar, and was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Duxing'a to Fengtian, served in Chahar, and was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，起授烏里雅蘇台將軍，撫士卒，卹蒙部。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu he was raised general of Uliastai, comforted soldiers, and relieved Mongol banners.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6 he was raised Uliastai general, comforted soldiers, and relieved Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 十四年，創發，乞休。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he memorialized illness and retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he retired citing illness.

sentences.zh: 明年，卒，諡武靖。

translations.literal: The next year he died; he was posthumously titled Wujing.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he died and was posthumously titled Wujing.

sentences.zh: 額爾慶額，字藹堂，格何恩氏，隸滿洲鑲白旗，墨爾根城駐防。

translations.literal: E Erqing'e, courtesy name Aitang, of the Gehe'en clan, registered in the Manchu Bordered White Banner, garrisoned at Mo'ergen City.
translations.idiomatic: E Erqing'e, styled Aitang, of the Gehe'en clan, was registered in the Bordered White Banner and garrisoned at Mo'ergen.

sentences.zh: 以驍勇聞，歷遷至委參領。

translations.literal: Known for fierce bravery he was promoted in succession to acting battalion commander.
translations.idiomatic: Known for fierce bravery he rose to acting battalion commander.

sentences.zh: 清水堡之役，賜號法福靈阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the Qingshui Fort campaign he was granted the title Fafu Ling'a Baturn.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingshui Fort he received the title Fafu Ling'a Baturn.

sentences.zh: 會諸軍克狄道，授黑龍江副總管。

translations.literal: When the armies jointly took Didao he was appointed Heilongjiang deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: When armies jointly took Didao he was appointed Heilongjiang deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 剿金縣竄匪，擢涼州副都統。

translations.literal: Suppressing fleeing bandits in Jin County he was promoted Liangzhou deputy lieutenant general.
translations.idiomatic: Suppressing fleeing bandits in Jin County he was promoted Liangzhou deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 命佐關外軍事，統領吉、黑騎旅頓西湖，令寇不得西。

translations.literal: Ordered to assist in frontier military affairs he commanded Jilin and Heilongjiang cavalry encamped at Xihu, keeping bandits from going west.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to assist frontier affairs he commanded Jilin and Heilongjiang cavalry at Xihu, blocking western movement.

sentences.zh: 烏城回自奎屯敗退安集海，擊卻之。

translations.literal: Wucheng Muslims retreated from Kuitun to Anjihai and were repelled.
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng Muslims retreated from Kuitun to Anjihai and were repelled.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，聞白彥虎構瑪納斯南北二城回擾糧道，與總兵馮桂增、參將徐學功約期會師大河廠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, hearing Bai Yanhu stirred north and south Manas city Muslims to harass the grain route, he with Brigade General Feng Guizeng and Colonel Xu Xuegong agreed to join forces at Dahechang.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2, hearing Yanhu stirred Manas Muslims to harass grain routes, he agreed with Feng Guizeng and Xu Xuegong to join at Dahechang.

sentences.zh: 額、馮二軍先行，徑薄北城，而南城回湧至，桂增負傷墜馬，寇舁入城。

translations.literal: E and Feng's armies went first and pressed straight on the north city; but south city Muslims surged up; Guizeng was wounded and fell from his horse; bandits carried him into the city.
translations.idiomatic: E and Feng went first against the north city; south city Muslims surged up; Guizeng was wounded and captured.

sentences.zh: 額爾慶額憤甚，先登陷陣，斬寇無算。

translations.literal: E Erqing'e was furious; first to ascend he pierced the line and beheaded bandits beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: E Erqing'e was furious; first up the walls he killed countless rebels.

sentences.zh: 因士卒傷亡多，止戰。

translations.literal: Because soldiers were wounded and killed in great numbers battle ceased.
translations.idiomatic: With heavy casualties battle ceased.

sentences.zh: 屆期學功至，距城十餘裡，見額爾慶額被創還，遂率所部救之。

translations.literal: When the date came Xuegong arrived; more than ten li from the city he saw E Erqing'e wounded returning and then led his unit to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Xuegong arrived on schedule; ten li from the city he saw E Erqing'e wounded returning and led his unit to rescue.

sentences.zh: 金順責其援不力，宗棠曰：「額爾慶額等輕進貪功，咎由自取。

translations.literal: Jin Shun blamed him for weak relief; Zuo Zongtang said, "E Erqing'e and others advanced rashly greedy for merit; blame lies with themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun blamed weak relief; Zuo said: "E Erqing'e advanced rashly for merit; blame lies with themselves.

sentences.zh: 且先夕進攻，學功何能豫知耶？」

translations.literal: Besides, the night before attacking, how could Xuegong have known beforehand?"
translations.idiomatic: Besides, attacking the night before, how could Xuegong have known?"

sentences.zh: 歷古城領隊大臣、科布多幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: He served as Gucheng garrison commander and Kobdo assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Gucheng garrison commander and Kobdo assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 命偕參贊大臣升泰勘界，以奎峒山為科、塔兩城外蔽，哈巴河南流入中國，與俄官抗爭，始得展地定界。

translations.literal: Ordered with Assistant Commander Sheng Tai to survey the border, taking Kuidong Mountain as outer shield of Kobdo and Tacheng, and the Khaba River flowing south into China; he contended with Russian officials and at last gained extended territory and fixed the border.
translations.idiomatic: With Sheng Tai surveying the border, taking Kuidong Mountain as outer shield and the Khaba River flowing south into China, he contended with Russians and fixed extended territory.

sentences.zh: 新疆底定，晉頭品秩。

translations.literal: When Xinjiang was settled he was promoted to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: When Xinjiang was settled he rose to first rank.

sentences.zh: 十二年，調伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was transferred to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was transferred to Ili.

sentences.zh: 伊犁設副都統自此始。

translations.literal: Establishing a deputy lieutenant general at Ili began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili deputy lieutenant general post began with him.

sentences.zh: 蒞任七年，興辦屯田，軍民輯睦。

translations.literal: In seven years in office he promoted garrison farming; army and people lived in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: In seven years he promoted garrison farming; army and people lived in harmony.

sentences.zh: 十九年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died; mourning followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 丰紳，字漢文，吳扎拉氏，隸滿洲正白旗，吉林駐防。

translations.literal: Feng Shen, courtesy name Hanwen, of the Wuzhala clan, registered in the Manchu Plain White Banner, garrisoned at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shen, styled Hanwen, of the Wuzhala clan, was registered in the Plain White Banner and garrisoned at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 都興阿督江北軍，檄守揚州，以戰功歷遷至協領。

translations.literal: When Duxing'a commanded the northern Jiang army he was ordered to guard Yangzhou; for battle merit he was promoted in succession to assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Under Duxing'a's northern Jiang command he guarded Yangzhou and rose to assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 克寶豐，取寧夏，數獲勝。

translations.literal: He took Baofeng and Ningxia and won repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: He took Baofeng and Ningxia and won repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善遣往靈州招撫，馬化龍就撫。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan sent him to Lingzhou to recruit and pacify; Ma Hualong submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan sent him to Lingzhou to pacify; Ma Hualong submitted.

sentences.zh: 穆圖善上其功，晉副都統。

translations.literal: Mu Tushan reported his merit; he was promoted deputy lieutenant general.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Tushan reported his merit and he was promoted deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 尋護寧夏將軍。

translations.literal: Soon he served acting Ningxia general.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he served acting Ningxia general.

sentences.zh: 時伏莽未靖，自寧城至靈州，隘口數十，為商旅來往孔道，丰紳詰姦禁暴，行旅便之。

translations.literal: At this time hidden bandits were not yet quiet; from Ning city to Lingzhou were several tens of passes, the thoroughfare for merchants; Feng Shen checked spies and forbade violence; travelers found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Hidden bandits remained; from Ning to Lingzhou were dozens of passes on the merchant route; Feng Shen checked spies and forbade violence; travelers were grateful.

sentences.zh: 先後平陝匪西河、橫城堡，補官錦州，擢黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: He successively pacified Shaanxi bandits at Xihe and Hengchengbao, was restored to Jinzhou command, and was promoted Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Shaanxi bandits at Xihe and Hengchengbao, restored Jinzhou command, and was promoted Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 坐事褫職。

translations.literal: He was stripped of office for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He was stripped of office for an offense.

sentences.zh: 光緒間，起故官，歷綏遠城、江寧。

translations.literal: During Guangxu he was raised to former office and served Suiyuancheng and Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu he was restored and served Suiyuancheng and Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 中日事起，出駐通州，事寧回任。

translations.literal: When Sino-Japanese troubles arose he went out to garrison Tongzhou; when affairs settled he returned to his post.
translations.idiomatic: When Sino-Japanese troubles arose he garrisoned Tongzhou; when affairs settled he returned.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died.
