translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he died.

sentences.zh: 詔優恤，予建祠。

translations.literal: Generous mourning was ordered and a memorial shrine granted.
translations.idiomatic: Generous mourning was ordered and a memorial shrine granted.

sentences.zh: 御史彭述劾其侵冒，奪卹典。

translations.literal: Censor Peng Shu impeached him for embezzlement and mourning honors were revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Peng Shu impeached him for embezzlement and mourning honors were revoked.

sentences.zh: 文麟，字瑞圃，兀扎拉氏，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Lin, courtesy name Ruipu, of the Wuzhala clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin, styled Ruipu, of the Wuzhala clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光二十二年，考取內閣中書，遷侍讀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Daoguang he passed the examination for Grand Secretariat copyist and was transferred reader.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 22 he passed the Grand Secretariat copyist examination and became a reader.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，出為甘肅蘭州道，調鎮迪。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng he went out as Gansu Lanzhou intendant and was transferred to Zhendi.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 8 he became Gansu Lanzhou intendant and was transferred to Zhendi.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，回竄據古城，文麟上防守奇台狀，上嘉其知大體。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi Muslims raided and held Gucheng; Wen Lin memorialized the defense of Qitai situation; the throne praised his grasp of essentials.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 4 Muslims held Gucheng; Wen Lin memorialized Qitai's defense and the throne praised his grasp of essentials.

sentences.zh: 濟木薩者，回眾屯糧地也。

translations.literal: Jimusa was Taranchi grain-gathering land.
translations.idiomatic: Jimusa was Taranchi grain-gathering land.

sentences.zh: 文麟潛遣練勇攻克之，獲糧萬數千石。

translations.literal: Wen Lin secretly sent trained braves to capture it and obtained tens of thousands of shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin secretly sent trained braves to capture it and obtained tens of thousands of shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 索煥章竄瑪納斯，分掠阜康、吐​​魯番、迪化。

translations.literal: Suo Huanzhang fled to Manas and divided forces to plunder Fukang, Turfan, and Dihua.
translations.idiomatic: Suo Huanzhang fled to Manas and plundered Fukang, Turfan, and Dihua.

sentences.zh: 文麟分兵扼三台要隘，上疏乞濟師。

translations.literal: Wen Lin divided troops to hold the Santai pass and memorialized begging reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin divided troops to hold Santai pass and begged reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 詔令嚴守濟木薩，援未至而哈密、奇台相繼淪失。

translations.literal: He was ordered to hold Jimusa strictly; aid had not arrived when Hami and Qitai fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to hold Jimusa, aid had not arrived when Hami and Qitai fell.

sentences.zh: 亟與巴里坤領隊大臣訥爾濟合兵進擊。

translations.literal: He urgently joined Barkul Garrison Commander Ne'erji to advance and attack.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Barkul Garrison Commander Ne'erji to advance and attack.

sentences.zh: 聞寇集東路，使佐領恆昌先進，敗於奎蘇，而自請赴前敵。

translations.literal: Hearing bandits gathered on the east route he sent Assistant Commandant Hengchang ahead; defeated at Kuisu he himself asked to go to the front.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing bandits on the east route he sent Hengchang ahead; defeated at Kuisu he asked to go forward himself.

sentences.zh: 上怒，訶責之，下部議，坐擅離職守，降二級調用。

translations.literal: The throne was angry and rebuked him; the ministry deliberated; for leaving his post without authority he was demoted two ranks and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked him; for leaving his post without authority he was demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 詔以藍翎侍衛充哈密辦事大臣。

translations.literal: He was ordered to serve as Hami affairs commissioner with Blue Feather attendant rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered Hami affairs commissioner with Blue Feather attendant rank.

sentences.zh: 文麟遂率所部收復城垣。

translations.literal: Wen Lin then led his troops to recover the city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin then led his troops to recover the walls.

sentences.zh: 馬金貴、白彥虎先後圍攻，瀕危者數矣，文麟拊循士卒，卒能以飢軍驅強敵，俾纏迴轉危為安。

translations.literal: Ma Jingui and Bai Yanhu successively besieged and attacked; danger came several times; Wen Lin comforted and guided soldiers and at last with a hungry army drove strong foes so Taranchis turned from peril to safety.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Jingui and Bai Yanhu besieged him repeatedly; Wen Lin comforted his hungry troops and drove strong foes so Taranchis turned from peril to safety.

sentences.zh: 五年，遭母憂，改署任。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he suffered his mother's mourning and served in acting capacity.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he mourned his mother and served in acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 明年，肅州回竄玉門，戰紅柳灣，敗之。

translations.literal: The next year Suzhou Muslims raided Yumen; at battle at Hongliuwang they were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Suzhou Muslims raided Yumen; he defeated them at Hongliuwang.

sentences.zh: 回復大舉犯城關，文麟督軍嚴守，伺間出擊。

translations.literal: Muslims again came in force against the city gate; Wen Lin directed the army in strict defense and struck when opportunity came.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims again assaulted the gates; Wen Lin defended strictly and struck when opportunity came.

sentences.zh: 圍解，乃為籌耕種，葺廬舍，訓練軍士，且戰且屯。

translations.literal: When the siege was lifted he then planned farming, repaired dwellings, trained soldiers, fighting while farming.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege lifted he planned farming, repaired dwellings, trained troops, and fought while farming.

sentences.zh: 服闋，以頭等侍衛補本官。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was appointed first-rank attendant to fill his former post.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he returned as first-rank attendant.

sentences.zh: 益招哈密團首孔才至，以其練勇二百編入伍籍，遣往古城興屯修堡。

translations.literal: He further recruited Hami militia chief Kong Cai, enrolled his two hundred trained braves in the rolls, and sent them to Gucheng to establish garrison farms and repair forts.
translations.idiomatic: He recruited Hami militia chief Kong Cai, enrolled two hundred trained braves, and sent them to Gucheng for garrison farms and forts.

sentences.zh: 後收徐學功散勇二千餘，任耕戰。

translations.literal: Later he enrolled more than two thousand of Xu Xuegong's scattered braves for farming and fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Later he enrolled more than two thousand of Xu Xuegong's scattered braves for farming and fighting.

sentences.zh: 於是古田、濟木薩屯政大舉。

translations.literal: Thus garrison farming at Gutian and Jimusa was greatly expanded.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison farming at Gutian and Jimusa was greatly expanded.

sentences.zh: 令充裨將，自是數與妥明、馬明、白彥虎相攻殺，所向皆捷。

translations.literal: He was ordered brigade general; from then he repeatedly fought Tuoming, Maming, and Bai Yanhu and won wherever he went.
translations.idiomatic: Made brigade general, he repeatedly fought Tuoming, Maming, and Bai Yanhu and won wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 十二年，肅城回數出關犯哈密東山，文麟令魏忠義出駐塔爾納沁堡，分扼各隘，剿撫馬賊，擒回馬五十九。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Suzhou Muslims repeatedly came out to raid Hami East Mountain; Wen Lin ordered Wei Zhongyi to garrison Ta'ernaqin Fort and hold each pass, suppressing and pacifying horse bandits and capturing fifty-nine Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Suzhou Muslims raided Hami East Mountain; Wen Lin garrisoned Ta'ernaqin, held the passes, and captured fifty-nine Muslims.

sentences.zh: 旋魏軍大失利，文麟飛章自劾，被宥，益感奮，率所部進擊，力保危城。

translations.literal: Soon Wei's army suffered great defeat; Wen Lin urgently memorialized self-impeachment, was pardoned, and was further stirred to lead his troops forward and forcefully preserve the endangered city.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's army suffered great defeat; Wen Lin self-impeached, was pardoned, and fought harder to preserve the endangered city.

sentences.zh: 降敕褒嘉，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: An edict of praise and commendation was sent down; he was given deputy lieutenant general rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised him and he received deputy lieutenant general rank.

sentences.zh: 明年，彥虎援肅州，潰退安敦玉，文麟使騎旅追之，彥虎遁入山，肅州平。

translations.literal: The next year Yanhu aided Suzhou; routed he retreated to Andunyu; Wen Lin sent cavalry in pursuit; Yanhu fled into the mountains and Suzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Yanhu aided Suzhou; routed at Andunyu, Wen Lin's cavalry pursued; Yanhu fled into the mountains and Suzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 詔張曜等馳赴哈密，會文麟進剿。

translations.literal: He was ordered Zhang Yao and others to hurry to Hami and join Wen Lin in advance suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao and others were ordered to Hami to join Wen Lin in advance suppression.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he died.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 he died.

sentences.zh: 文麟治軍數載，囊無私蓄，與士卒同甘苦，故人皆原為盡命。

translations.literal: Wen Lin governed the army several years without private savings; he shared hardship with soldiers; therefore men were willing to give their lives for him.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin governed the army for years without private savings and shared hardship with soldiers; men willingly gave their lives for him.

sentences.zh: 及其沒也，闔營慟哭失聲。

translations.literal: When he died the whole camp wept aloud.
translations.idiomatic: When he died the whole camp wept aloud.

sentences.zh: 明春、富勒銘額先後狀其績以上，予褒卹，附祀新疆哈密專祠。

translations.literal: Ming Chun and Fuleiming'e successively reported his achievements upward; generous mourning was granted and attached worship at the Xinjiang Hami dedicated shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Chun and Fuleiming'e reported his achievements; generous mourning was granted with attached worship at the Xinjiang Hami shrine.

sentences.zh: 明春，巴羽特氏，隸蒙古正紅旗。

translations.literal: Ming Chun, of the Bayute clan, was registered in the Mongol Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Chun, of the Bayute clan, was registered in the Mongol Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 初從勝保平河北，補前鋒校。

translations.literal: At first he followed Sheng Bao in pacifying north Hebei and was appointed vanguard commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He first followed Sheng Bao in north Hebei and was appointed vanguard commandant.

sentences.zh: 徵陝回，隸多隆阿麾下，以戰功數遷副都統。

translations.literal: Campaigning against Shaanxi Muslims he served under Duolong'a and for battle merit was repeatedly promoted to deputy lieutenant general.
translations.idiomatic: Against Shaanxi Muslims under Duolong'a he rose repeatedly to deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 搗肅州，壓城為壘，與回相持者半載，追藍得全被重創。

translations.literal: Storming Suzhou he pressed the city with ramparts and was locked with the Muslims half a year; pursuing Landequan he was heavily wounded.
translations.idiomatic: Storming Suzhou he pressed the city half a year; pursuing Landequan he was heavily wounded.

sentences.zh: 肅州回出掠安西、玉門、敦煌，明春馳逐三城間，三月，圍悉解，授哈密幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: Suzhou Muslims came out to plunder Anxi, Yumen, and Dunhuang; Ming Chun galloped among the three cities; in the third month all sieges were lifted; he was appointed Hami assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou Muslims plundered Anxi, Yumen, and Dunhuang; Ming Chun galloped among the three cities; by the third month all sieges were lifted and he was appointed Hami assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，擢辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was promoted affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 2 he was promoted affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 時南疆平，肅纏民悉還故土。

translations.literal: At this time the southern route was pacified and Suzhou Taranchis all returned to their lands.
translations.idiomatic: The southern route was pacified and Suzhou Taranchis returned to their lands.

sentences.zh: 明春為晰地畝給貲糧，勸使復業。

translations.literal: Ming Chun clarified land acreage and gave provisions and grain, urging them to resume livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Chun clarified land acreage, gave provisions, and urged them to resume livelihood.

sentences.zh: 凡治道路，繕堤防，興水利，有裨民生久遠者，靡不具舉，民德之，至今猶虔祀雲。

translations.literal: In repairing roads, dikes, and promoting irrigation—whatever benefited people's livelihood for the long term—nothing was left undone; the people esteemed him and still reverently worship him.
translations.idiomatic: Roads, dikes, irrigation—whatever benefited long-term livelihood he undertook; people still reverently worship him.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died; mourning followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 富勒銘額，佚其氏，隸滿洲鑲白旗，古城駐防。

translations.literal: Fuleiming'e—his clan is unknown—was registered in the Manchu Bordered White Banner, garrisoned at Gucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Fuleiming'e—clan unknown—was registered in the Bordered White Banner and garrisoned at Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊陷，古城大恐。

translations.literal: When Urumqi fell Gucheng was greatly terrified.
translations.idiomatic: When Urumqi fell Gucheng was terrified.

sentences.zh: 富勒銘額出與寇戰，數被創。

translations.literal: Fuleiming'e went out to fight bandits and was wounded several times.
translations.idiomatic: Fuleiming'e fought bandits and was wounded several times.

sentences.zh: 事亟，如烏里雅蘇台乞援，弗應，城破，全家殉焉。

translations.literal: When affairs were urgent he went to Uliastai begging aid; there was no response; the city fell and the whole family died martyrs.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs grew urgent he begged Uliastai for aid; none came; the city fell and his whole family died martyrs.

sentences.zh: 富勒銘額適在外，得免於難，憤詣文麟軍所，原從殺賊。

translations.literal: Fuleiming'e happened to be outside and escaped disaster; in anger he went to Wen Lin's army and volunteered to kill bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Fuleiming'e was outside and escaped; in anger he joined Wen Lin's army to kill bandits.

sentences.zh: 紅柳灣之役，以功擢防禦。

translations.literal: In the Hongliuwang campaign for merit he was promoted defense commandant.
translations.idiomatic: At Hongliuwang he was promoted defense commandant for merit.

sentences.zh: 回擾安西，設計抗禦，斬虜多，並蒐治西山逸匪，盡殲之，解敦煌圍，晉頭品秩，賜號堅勇巴圖魯，充古城協領。

translations.literal: Muslims harassed Anxi; he designed defense, beheaded many captives, also searched out west mountain fugitive bandits and wiped them all out, lifted Dunhuang siege, was promoted first rank, granted the title Jianyong Baturn, and appointed Gucheng assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims harassed Anxi; he designed defense, killed many, wiped out west mountain fugitives, lifted Dunhuang's siege, rose to first rank, received the title Jianyong Baturn, and became Gucheng assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 西陲告寧，置屯田，修兵房。

translations.literal: When the western frontier was declared calm he established garrison farms and repaired barracks.
translations.idiomatic: When the frontier was calm he established garrison farms and repaired barracks.

sentences.zh: 以都統恭钅堂薦，光緒十四年，授伊犁副都統。

translations.literal: On Commander-in-Chief Gong Tang's recommendation, in the fourteenth year of Guangxu he was appointed Ili deputy lieutenant general.
translations.idiomatic: On Gong Tang's recommendation, in Guangxu 14 he was appointed Ili deputy lieutenant general.

sentences.zh: 時游勇構哈薩克回寇邊，富勒銘額遣軍捕其酋，餘燼悉平。

translations.literal: At this time roaming braves stirred Kazakh Muslims to raid the border; Fuleiming'e sent troops to capture their chieftain and the remaining embers were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Roaming braves stirred Kazakh raids; Fuleiming'e captured their chieftain and pacified the rest.

sentences.zh: 十六年，署將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he served acting general.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he served acting general.

sentences.zh: 增卡倫，整營製，索倫、錫伯、察哈爾、額魯特兵卒咸复游牧舊業。

translations.literal: He added border posts, reorganized camp regulations; Solon, Xibo, Chahar, and Elute soldiers and troops all resumed their old nomadic livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: He added border posts, reorganized camps; Solon, Xibo, Chahar, and Elute troops resumed nomadic livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 十九年，徙塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，練軍興屯，收還巴爾魯克山，清界置卡，其治复仿伊犁，屹然成重鎮。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was transferred Tarbagatai assistant commissioner, trained troops and established garrison farms, recovered the Ba'erluke Mountains, cleared borders and set posts; his governance modeled on Ili and firmly became a strategic strongpoint.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he became Tarbagatai assistant commissioner, trained troops, farmed garrisons, recovered Ba'erluke Mountains, and cleared borders—his rule modeled on Ili and made a strategic strongpoint.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，乞歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he begged to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he retired.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，卒，卹如製。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died; mourning followed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he died; mourning followed regulation.

sentences.zh: 學功，烏魯木齊農家子。

translations.literal: Xuegong was a farm boy of Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xuegong was a farm boy from Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 好技擊，值回亂，結健兒數十，掠回莊貲貨以自贍。

translations.literal: Fond of martial arts, when the Muslim rebellion arose he gathered several dozen stalwarts and plundered Muslim villages for goods to support themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Fond of martial arts, when rebellion arose he gathered stalwarts and plundered Muslim villages to support themselves.

sentences.zh: 遇漢民，力護之，雖邊外悍回皆已憚之矣。

translations.literal: Meeting Han people he forcefully protected them; even fierce Muslims on the frontier already feared him.
translations.idiomatic: He forcefully protected Han people; even fierce frontier Muslims feared him.

sentences.zh: 厥後附者益眾，集五千人，精練馬隊，每戰突陣，驟若風雨，回見之輒走。

translations.literal: Later followers increased; he gathered five thousand men, drilled cavalry finely; in each battle he pierced the line; sudden as wind and rain; Muslims seeing him always fled.
translations.idiomatic: Followers increased to five thousand; he drilled fine cavalry that pierced lines like wind and rain; Muslims fled at sight of him.

sentences.zh: 學功先後陣斬偽帥馬泰、阿奇木馬仲。

translations.literal: Xuegong successively beheaded in battle false commanders Ma Tai and Aqim Ma Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: Xuegong beheaded false commanders Ma Tai and Aqim Ma Zhong in battle.

sentences.zh: 仲子人得襲偽職，與妥明積不相能，妥明復以黨攻之。

translations.literal: Zhong's son Rendé inherited the false post and was deeply at odds with Tuoming; Tuoming again attacked him with his faction.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong's son Rendé inherited the false post and clashed with Tuoming, who attacked him with his faction.

sentences.zh: 安酋帕夏乃約學功破吐魯番，進攻烏魯木齊，下之。

translations.literal: The Andijani Khan Ya'qub Beg then allied with Xuegong to break Turfan and advance on Urumqi and take it.
translations.idiomatic: Andijani Khan Ya'qub Beg allied with Xuegong to break Turfan, advance on Urumqi, and take it.

sentences.zh: 妥明走綏來，數日死，​​帕夏遂據烏垣。

translations.literal: Tuoming fled to Suilai and died within days; the Khan then held Wuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoming fled to Suilai and died within days; the Khan then held Wuyuan.

sentences.zh: 初，帕夏以學功善戰，故與交驩，冀藉其力，王哈密，以南八城，歸獻朝廷，已，知其無遠略，且百戰未得一階，益輕之，令還綏來南山。

translations.literal: At first the Khan because Xuegong fought well befriended him, hoping to borrow his strength to rule Hami and the southern eight cities and return them to the court; soon knowing he lacked far-reaching design and after a hundred battles had not gained a single rank, he despised him further and ordered him back to Suilai South Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Khan befriended Xuegong for his fighting, hoping to rule Hami and the southern eight cities for the court; soon seeing he lacked vision and after a hundred battles had no rank, he despised him and sent him to Suilai South Mountain.

sentences.zh: 於是學功大恚，屢攻烏垣，其民人時降學功，時投人得，轉輾屬役，迄不得息。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xuegong was greatly resentful and repeatedly attacked Wuyuan; its people sometimes submitted to Xuegong and sometimes to Rendé, shifting allegiance in turn, never finding rest.
translations.idiomatic: Xuegong grew resentful and repeatedly attacked Wuyuan; its people shifted between him and Rendé, never finding rest.

sentences.zh: 同治七年，俄人構土回纏頭將襲烏垣，聲赴綏來易市，驅駝馬數千，載貨鈔至石河，去綏來八十里。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tongzhi Russians stirred local Muslims and Taranchis planning to raid Wuyuan, claiming to go to Suilai for trade, driving several thousand camels and horses loaded with goods and paper money to Shihe, eighty li from Suilai.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7 Russians stirred local Muslims and Taranchis to raid Wuyuan, claiming trade at Suilai, driving thousands of camels loaded with goods to Shihe, eighty li from Suilai.

sentences.zh: 學功以騎旅截之，僇數十人，餘縱還。

translations.literal: Xuegong with cavalry intercepted them, killed several tens of men, and let the rest return.
translations.idiomatic: Xuegong intercepted with cavalry, killed dozens, and let the rest return.

sentences.zh: 自此俄人不敢東窺。

translations.literal: From then Russians did not dare look east.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Russians did not dare look east.

sentences.zh: 十二年，彥虎率悍回數千分掠烏垣、綏來，學功复橫截之，殺數百人，奪橐駝五百。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Yanhu led several thousand fierce Muslims to divide plunder between Wuyuan and Suilai; Xuegong again cut across and killed several hundred men and seized five hundred pack camels.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Yanhu led fierce Muslims to plunder Wuyuan and Suilai; Xuegong intercepted, killed hundreds, and seized five hundred camels.

sentences.zh: 彥虎勢益孤。

translations.literal: Yanhu's strength grew ever more isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Yanhu grew ever more isolated.

sentences.zh: 學功既任職，但承大將風指，異於初起血戰時矣。

translations.literal: After Xuegong received office he only followed the great commander's signals, unlike the blood fighting of his early rise.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving office he only followed great commanders' signals, unlike his early blood fighting.

sentences.zh: 後與孔才並官至提督。

translations.literal: Later he and Kong Cai both reached provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: Later he and Kong Cai both reached provincial military commander.

sentences.zh: 孔才，哈密人。

translations.literal: Kong Cai was a native of Hami.
translations.idiomatic: Kong Cai came from Hami.

sentences.zh: 論曰：從左宗棠立功西陲最名者，湘軍中稱二劉，豫軍中稱曜。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Among those who followed Zuo Zongtang to merit on the western frontier the most famed in the Hunan Army were called the Two Lius; in the Henan Army, Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Among Zuo Zongtang's western frontier merit-makers, the Hunan Army had the Two Lius; the Henan Army had Yao.

sentences.zh: 之數人者，投袂攘難，不數月，廓清萬里，雖張騫、班超，奚多讓焉！

translations.literal: These several men shook their sleeves to repel disaster; in not many months they cleared ten thousand li; even Zhang Qian and Ban Chao would hardly yield!
translations.idiomatic: These men shook off comfort to meet disaster; in months they cleared ten thousand li—Zhang Qian and Ban Chao would hardly surpass them.

sentences.zh: 金順、穆圖善提塞北健兒，橫行玉門、金岭間，其志尤壯。

translations.literal: Jin Shun and Mu Tushan led hardy northern sons and ranged between Yumen and the Golden Ridge; their ambition was especially bold.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun and Mu Tushan led hardy northern troops between Yumen and the Golden Ridge with especially bold ambition.

sentences.zh: 文麟名出二人下，而招團興屯，兼任★戰，不煩國家一兵，遂定西邊，其功亦足並傳云。

translations.literal: Wen Lin's fame ranked below the two, yet in recruiting militia and establishing garrison farms, combining farming with fighting, without troubling the state for a single soldier he settled the western border; his merit is also enough to be recorded alongside them.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Lin ranked below the two in fame, yet by recruiting militia, establishing garrison farms, and fighting while farming—without costing the state a single soldier—he settled the western border; his merit deserves equal record.
